jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Stories Illuminated we are storytellers. With an emphasis on Blue Sky Thinking, we utilize the creative technologies of lighting, sound, video, and special effects to create magic for every project and bring innovation to every design. Collaborative\-driven, our process focuses on the creative interactions between clients, brands, studios, technologists, and designers. We encourage continual learning, investigation, and reflection within our team to inspire new perspectives and create revolutionary solutions. Stories Illuminated’s goal is for our team to become the best version of themselves while telling special stories throughout the world.

**SUMMARY:** The Project Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the success of projects by coordinating the technical, administrative, and personnel needs of installations and events, while working closely under the supervision of Project and Operational Leads. They assist in organizing all aspects of events from conception to execution and support the team to ensure client objectives are achieved.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Support project and operational Leads with event production and logistics related to lighting, audio, video, and special effects, from pre\-production through project wrap.
* Collaborate with project leads to create, document, and approve event production plans including objectives, scopes, schedules, and budgets.
* Partner with project leads to staff events while keeping labor costs on budget.
* Track production schedules, monitor progress, and proactively communicate status of assigned projects to the leadership team on an ongoing basis.
* Track budgets to ensure cost management while delivering on client objectives.
* Ensure projects run smoothly, proactively identifying and resolving risks and challenges.
* Communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders including designers, technicians, vendors, and clients to keep everyone in the loop.
* Assist Project Lead in scheduling meetings; attend project meetings and ensure all details are appropriately captured, recorded, and distributed.
* Gather and maintain paperwork such as permits, client files, run of show, etc.
* Coordinate project logistics such as deliveries, travel, site needs, credentials, etc.
* Seek and document required approvals from clients, internal, and external teams.
* Support the design team and crew onsite, participating in walkthroughs, and conducting follow\-ups to make sure everything goes off without a hitch.
* Document completed projects with photos and notes for company portfolio and social.
* Complete comprehensive postmortems, gathering feedback into an overall report.
* Maintain a professional, supportive, and safe work environment, in\-office and on\-site.
* Act as point of contact on\-site to ensure everyone has the logistical information they need to arrive, check in, and start working.

* Degree in event management or related field, or equivalent experience

* Thorough understanding of various aspects of live events production.
* Valid driver's license, able to deliver gear to site, and occasionally drive cargo vans.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant/Special Projects Coordinator - Patient Access Organization
jobs.description:
**Description**  

UCLA Health runs and operates over 300 outpatient clinics located in Southern California with over 3,000,000 outpatient encounters annually. The Patient Access Organization (PAO) serves as the centralized access team for UCLA Health’s ambulatory enterprise, ensuring timely, convenient, and equitable access to care for patients and the communities we serve. Our teams oversee high\-volume centralized scheduling and call center operations, new patient referral intake and navigation, enterprise template and capacity management, workforce training and quality oversight, and scheduling pathways and technology optimization, including decision tree development and digital innovations. We operate at the intersection of operations, technology, and clinical partnership to align supply and demand, streamline workflows, and continuously improve how patients enter and engage with UCLA Health.



The Executive Assistant/Special Projects Coordinator for the PAO provides professional analytical support, project coordination and management, as well as specialized and general administrative support. The incumbent is responsible for managing the Senior Director's calendar, correspondence, administrative tasks and various projects as assigned. This role will also support other leadership team members across the PAO.

  

Pay range: $33\.81 \- $53\.93 an hour  

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training
* Ability to multi\-task and prioritize assignments to complete work in a timely manner despite competing priorities and conflicting deadlines.
* Analytical skills to evaluate data, solve problems, draw conclusions and make sound recommendations.
* Financial skills sufficient to calculate percentages, ratios, rates in order to: determine costs, provide financial projections, and prepare analytical reports.
* Effective writing skills to develop concise, effective and professional business correspondence, presentations and reports
* Effective verbal communications and interpersonal skills to actively listen, respond to the business need, and convey information concisely and professionally with individuals at all levels of the organization
* Demonstrated skills in using various software, such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, in a Windows environment.
* Ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with staff, coworkers and public.
* Ability to work independently and follow through on assignments with minimal direction
* Ability to work with confidential and highly sensitive information with discretion.
* Ability to establish and maintain positive, effective working relationships with peers, leaders, and staff.
* Ability to work accurately with details.
* Ability to demonstrate good judgement in all aspects of the job.
* Demonstrates the values of the organization: CICARE
* Demonstrate commitment to serving both the internal and external customers.

**POSITION SUMMARY**  

This position supports the work of the Y, a leading nonprofit committed to strengthening community through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility. The Teen Coordinator, develops positive, nurturing relationships with students while building cooperative relationships with parents \& caregivers. Promotes and supports the potential of all youth in programs and facilitates peer\-to\-peer connections as part of the overall program experience. Provides direction for the teens in programs, and lead classes focused on skills based learning. Provides a quality experience to teens that focuses on building achievement and belonging in teens. The Teen Coordinator is responsible for carrying out curriculum of the YMCA Teen Department to ensure student/participant involvement and academic achievement through utilization of technology and team building activities. This person will also create a positive environment for participants in an at\-risk area of the community.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Develop robust recruitment strategy to enlist new student participants into the program.
* Plan and coordinate Teen Night monthly schedule and learning plan.
* Write and carry out day to day curriculum and lesson plans relating to teaching media skills, cooking, gardening, arts and crafts, college exploration, career readiness, functional skills, and more.
* Directly provide instruction for youth in the above lesson plan subject areas using creative hands\-on project\-based approaches.

* Understand and carry out the best practices of Youth Development.
* Track the progress of youth in the program and individualize the instruction as needed to ensure that all youth gain new skills and are successful.

**Job Description**
-------------------


This is a **hybrid, per diem position** with a significant portion of the role performed outside of the office attending graduate fairs, recruitment events, and other academic outreach activities throughout the greater Los Angeles area.


The Academic Outreach Coordinator will independently research and identify relevant outreach opportunities, develop and manage an event schedule, coordinate participation, maintain outreach records, and communicate upcoming activities and outcomes to the HSU team. The role requires regular local travel within the Los Angeles area and flexibility based on the timing and location of scheduled events.


The Academic Outreach Coordinator for Cedars\-Sinai Health Sciences University (HSU) supports student recruitment, community engagement, and outreach initiatives designed to expand prospective student pipelines and strengthen institutional visibility. This role serves as a key representative of the HSU, building relationships with educational institutions, community organizations, and internal stakeholders to support enrollment growth and outreach objectives.
  

  

The Academic Outreach Coordinator represents the HSU at recruitment events, information sessions, community outreach activities, and partner engagements. Responsibilities include managing prospective student communications and follow\-up activities, supporting recruitment campaigns, coordinating outreach initiatives across Cedars\-Sinai departments and external partners, and maintaining accurate engagement data within customer relationship management (CRM) and student information systems.
  

  

This position collaborates closely with admissions, marketing, academic leadership, and community partners to develop and implement data\-informed recruitment and engagement strategies that advance HSU enrollment goals and strengthen community partnerships.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Database management: Experience tracking contacts, outreach activities, and engagement using HubSpot, Maestro, or similar database/CRM systems.
* Data analysis and reporting: Experience analyzing response rates, attendance, and enrollment data using Excel and/or reporting dashboards.

**Hadrian \- Manufacturing the Future**
=======================================


Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full\-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission\-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

  

Following our $1\.37B Series D at a $7\.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory\-as\-a\-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

  

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

  

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**The Role**
------------


Hadrian is hiring an Experiential Marketing Manager to own every moment where someone meets Hadrian in person. This is the single owner of our events portfolio, from a twelve\-person dinner in a private room to a flagship launch built around a working factory floor.

The people we most want to reach, the engineers building autonomous systems and the machinists and technicians who run them, do not decide where to spend the next five years of their career because of an ad. This is a builder role with real budget and real autonomy, not a coordinator role executing someone else’s brief.

**Why Now**
-----------


We are scaling our manufacturing footprint across multiple sites and hiring aggressively into the Bay Area and beyond, and our events calendar is about to go from occasional to continuous. Several things are already live: recruiting\-driven dinners and socials, a multi\-month brand and talent campaign anchored in the Bay Area, and a set of factory and site moments tied to new capability launches. * Own the events budget, including vendor selection, negotiation, production spend, and reconciliation. Bring a point of view on where a dollar buys more experience.

**Build the flagship moments**

* Develop formats that travel, so a dinner series or demo night can run in a new city without rebuilding it from scratch each time.

jobs.title: Outside Sales & Account Manager – Property Management & Restaurant Accounts
jobs.description:
**Commercial Account Manager – Outside Sales, Plumbing Services (LA)**

EZ Plumbing – North Hollywood, CA  
Full\-time \| Salary \+ commission  
$48,000 base salary \+ uncapped commission \| $70,000–78,000 first year at quota \| $85,000–110,000 years two and three

EZ Plumbing has served the LA area since 1989\. We're hiring one person to build and own a book of commercial accounts: property management companies, HOAs, apartment buildings, and restaurants. Half the job is landing them. The other half is keeping them, growing them, and being the person they call. You get paid on everything your accounts spend with us for as long as they stay yours.

This is a field role. You'll be in property management offices, on job sites, and in restaurant back doors, not behind a desk.

The two halves of the job

**Landing accounts**

* Cold walk\-ins, calls, and follow\-ups to property managers, HOA boards, building owners, and restaurant operators across the LA metro
* Get EZ Plumbing onto vendor lists, get rate sheets accepted, and get maintenance agreements signed
* Deliver our vendor packet (license, insurance, W\-9, references) and walk them through it
* 15\+ in\-person visits and 40\+ total touches per week during your first year

**Managing accounts**

* Quarterly check\-in with every account in your book, in person or by phone, and a visit anytime an account goes quiet
* Own renewals: annual rate sheet updates and maintenance agreement renewals
* Grow the account: turn a one\-time repair customer into a scheduled program (drain jetting, sump and storm drain maintenance, backflow testing, water heater service, grease and floor drain service for restaurants)
* Be the first call when a property manager has a problem with a job. You don't fix it, you own it: get dispatch and the tech involved, follow it through, and call the customer back
* Stay on top of your accounts' invoices. You know the property manager, so you call before accounting does
* Track account health in ServiceTitan: last job date, revenue trend, open receivables. Nothing in your book goes 90 days without a touch
* Weekly report to the owner: new accounts, visits, accounts touched, at\-risk accounts, receivables over 60 days

Your first year is roughly 70% hunting and 30% managing. As your book grows, that flips. By year three most of your time is managing 60 to 80 accounts that pay you every month.

**Who we're looking for**

* 2\+ years outside sales, door\-to\-door, or field\-based B2B experience where you kept the accounts you signed. Route sales, uniforms, pest control, commercial cleaning, foodservice distribution, security, HVAC, or anyone who's sold to property managers: we want to talk to you
* You can walk into an office cold, get past the front desk, and leave with a name and a next step
* You follow up. Relentlessly. You have a system and you can describe it
* You've kept accounts for years, not just signed them, and you can tell us how
* You're comfortable being the person a customer calls when they're unhappy
* Organized enough to run a 50\-account book without letting any of them go cold
* Valid California driver's license and clean driving record
* Comfortable with 90% of your week in the field
* No plumbing experience required. We'll teach you what you need to sell it and manage it

**How you get paid**

* $48,000 base salary ($4,000/month), guaranteed
* $150 for every new account you sign, paid when their first invoice is paid
* 3% of everything your accounts pay us, labor and materials, for two years from the day they start, then 1% for as long as you keep the account active
* $2,000 quarterly bonus for hitting your account quota, keeping 90% of your book active, and keeping their bills current
* Year one at quota: $70,000–78,000\. Year two with a built book: $85,000–95,000\. Year three: $95,000–110,000, most of it recurring

The account management side is where the money is. The 1% that continues after year two, the retention bonus, and the growth from turning repair customers into maintenance programs are all paid for keeping accounts, not signing them.

Two things to know up front: commissions pay when the customer pays, not when the job is booked. And an account stays yours only if you're actively working it. Sign it and forget it and it goes back to the house.

**What we provide**

* Company vehicle or $500/month vehicle allowance, plus gas card
* Company phone and laptop
* All sales materials: rate sheets, one\-pagers, vendor packets, business cards
* Paid sick leave per California and City of LA law, 5 days vacation year one, 10 days year two

Not offered: health insurance, 401(k)

Schedule  
Monday to Friday, you set your own days within business hours. Exempt outside sales position, no overtime.

To apply  
Submit your resume and answer the screening questions. We read every answer. Candidates who pass move to a 15\-minute phone screen, then a ride\-along day with the owner.

EZ Plumbing is a family\-owned, C\-36 licensed plumbing contractor (CSLB \#583868\), 11478 Burbank Blvd, North Hollywood, CA 91601\.

Pay: $48,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Application Question(s):

* Describe the last job where most of your week was spent in the field making cold contacts. What did you sell and to whom?
* Walk me through your follow\-up system. What happens after a first visit where you got a name but no commitment?
* Tell me about an account you personally kept for two or more years. What did you do to keep it, and what did you do when they were unhappy?
* How did you track your accounts in your last role? What told you an account was about to leave?
* How many in\-person cold visits did you average per week in your last sales role?
* Do you have a valid California driver's license and a driving record insurable by a commercial policy?

Experience:

* Outside Sales, Field Sales, or Account Management.: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in

jobs.title: Cardiovascular Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Description**


The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self\-motivated, results\-oriented, and collaborative.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customers and accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross\-functional discipline is critical. Cross\-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision\-making.
* Demonstrate account\-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.).
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3\+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2\+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor\-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top\-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical \& analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.

  

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $120,000 to $130,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager and Graphic Designer
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Seven Arrows is a small\-by\-design, K–6 independent elementary school in Santa Monica, California. Our mission is to inspire students to be passionate learners and compassionate leaders who value life long learning and embody integrity. We are an academically rigorous school that believes the visual and performing arts, sportsmanship, and global citizenship are just as important as core homeroom subjects.

That spirit comes to life throughout the year in our cross\-curricular festivals and every Friday morning at Kuyam, our all\-community gathering featuring student performances, our parent band, interviews with our graduating sixth graders, and special guest speakers and performers. Everything we share with the world should reflect that full picture.

We're looking for a creative, versatile storyteller who can capture the many sides of life at Seven Arrows and help us tell our story with clarity, consistency, and heart.

**The Role**

The Social Media Manager \& Graphic Designer brings the school's visual and social presence to life. This person will translate our mission, vision, and the aesthetic into compelling content across social platforms, print, and digital materials. You'll work closely with the Head of School and senior leadership team to make sure every post and every design moves our message forward.

This role is ideal for someone who can quickly absorb an organization's identity, from its values and voice to its visual style, and then produce polished work at a steady, fast pace without losing quality.

**What You'll Do**

**Social Media**

* Plan, create, and publish content across platforms, maintaining a consistent content calendar aligned with the school year and key events.
* Capture the day\-to\-day life of the school through photography, short\-form video, and stories that reflect our mission and community.
* Capture and share signature school moments, including our weekly Kuyam gatherings and cross\-curricular festivals, through photography, video, and timely posts.
* Write captions and copy in the school's voice, ensuring every post supports our messaging priorities.
* Monitor engagement and analytics, share regular insights, and adjust strategy based on what resonates with families, prospective families, and alumni.
* Respond to comments and messages in a timely, professional manner and flag sensitive issues to leadership.

**Graphic Design**

* Design print and digital materials including, but not limited to: event invitations, newsletters, signage, presentations, social graphics, and programs for festivals.
* Create internal materials for the senior leadership team, such as organizational charts, presentations, facilities planning visuals, and other documents used for school operations and planning.
* Uphold the school's brand standards, ensuring all materials match the established aesthetic.
* Maintain an organized library of templates, brand assets, and photography.
* Manage multiple projects and competing deadlines, often with quick turnarounds during peak seasons.

**What We're Looking For**

**Brand and Mission Alignment**

* A strong instinct for understanding an organization's ethos, voice, and visual identity, and the ability to reflect it quickly and accurately in your work.
* Comfort taking direction and feedback from leadership, and turning it into refined work without losing momentum.
* Genuine interest in education, the magic of childhood, and in telling the story of a school community.

**Experience and Skills**

* 3–5 years of experience in social media management, graphic design, or a combined creative role; school, nonprofit, or mission\-driven experience is a plus.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Canva; video editing experience (Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar) strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of social scheduling and analytics tools.
* Solid photography and short\-form video skills.
* Excellent writing and editing skills with a sharp eye for detail.
* A portfolio that shows both social content and design work across print and digital.

**Work Style**

* Thrives in a fast\-paced environment and consistently delivers high\-quality work on tight timelines.
* Excellent collaborator and thrives when working in a team
* Highly organized, self\-directed, and able to juggle many projects at once.
* Adaptable and responsive to feedback.
* Available for occasional evening or weekend school events.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your resume, a brief cover letter, and a link to your portfolio. In your cover letter, tell us about a time you had to quickly learn and capture an organization's brand or voice. Finalists may be asked to complete a short design and social media exercise.

Pay: $72,000\.00 \- $78,000\.00 per year

* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Hiring a Marketing Specialist to join our team!


### **About Civica Law Group, APC**


Civica: noun. Latin, meaning civic\-oriented. The name Civica Law reflects the mission of our firm: service to communities and the public through assisting cities and counties in enforcing their laws effectively, efficiently and fairly, and defending agencies against risks and lawsuits they may face. Our team is made up of attorneys and paralegals who have spent their careers helping code enforcement and their public agencies protect and improve their communities. With over 75 collective years of experience, our team has helped cities and counties abate thousands of dangerous and substandard properties, improve housing conditions, and effectively deal with a wide range of quality\-of\-life issues, from homeless encampments to cannabis, drug, and gang dens to illegal gambling (or tap\-tap) facilities, illegal business operations, human trafficking and massage, land use, and zoning, and virtually every other conceivable quality of life and safety issue a public agency may face.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT CRAWFORD \& ASSOCIATES**


Crawford \& Associates, Inc. is a geotechnical engineering, engineering geology, and construction materials testing firm founded in 2012, now with over 85 employees across nine offices in California and Washington State. We're a team of engineers, geologists, and specialists who love solving tough problems, whether that's a bridge foundation, a water line, a new school, or the next big development. We build long\-term partnerships with our clients, give advice they can count on, and have fun doing it.  

**JOB SUMMARY**


Crawford \& Associates, Inc. is hiring a Business Development Coordinator for our Costa Mesa office that we opened this year. This role is a split between business development and recruiting. You will help find and win new work across Southern California, and help find and hire the people who deliver it. You will report to the Business Development Specialist and work closely with our principals, project managers, and construction services leadership.  

  

If you are a person who likes research, building relationships, and working with cool people, we want to hear from you.  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Business Development (approx. 50%)**** Research and track Southern California public agency opportunities, including capital improvement programs (CIPs), council agendas, planning documents, and bid/RFQ postings.
* Screen incoming leads for fit with Crawford's services and route them to the right principal or project manager with supporting research.
* Build competitive intelligence, including which firms have historically won civil and geotechnical work with target agencies.
* Maintain accurate opportunity, client, and contact information in Crawford's lead tracking system.
* Prepare for and participate in weekly proposals and business development meetings.
* Support client outreach and relationship building with agencies, prime consultants, and contractors.
* Coordinate and attend industry conferences, association events, and client meetings.

***Recruiting Support (approx. 40%)**** Partner with the Business Development Specialist, who oversees recruiting, to divide and manage open requisitions.
* Handle day\-to\-day recruiting work, with a focus on entry\-level and field roles such as engineering technicians, inspectors, interns, and staff engineers and geologists.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Indeed, job boards, referrals, and university partnerships.
* Post job openings, screen applicants, conduct initial phone screens, and schedule interviews.
* Manage candidate pipelines and keep records current in JazzHR, our applicant tracking system.
* Coordinate with hiring managers on interview feedback and next steps.
* Represent Crawford at career fairs and campus events, primarily in Southern California.

***Operational Support (approx. 10%)**** Provide light administrative support to the Costa Mesa office as needed.
* Assist with special projects in business development, recruiting, and HR as assigned.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Human Resources, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 1 to 3 years of experience in business development, recruiting, sales, or a similar client\- or candidate\-facing role.
* Ability to travel throughout Southern California, with occasional overnight stays.
* Valid California driver's license and reliable transportation.

  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams).
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines with minimal supervision.
* Team player who works well with engineers, field staff, and leadership.

  

**WORKING CONDITIONS**


This isn't a desk\-all\-day job. You'll split your time between our Costa Mesa office and getting out into Southern California: meeting clients, representing Crawford at industry events and conferences, and connecting with students at career fairs. You'll play a key role in helping us win work and supporting the people who do it. Your home base runs Monday through Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm, with the occasional evening or weekend event mixed in.  

**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS**


Crawford \& Associates, Inc. offers a comprehensive benefits package including employer\-paid medical coverage, dental and vision insurance, a competitive 401(k) plan with company matching, paid holidays, and a progressive PTO program. Additional perks include monthly cell phone reimbursement, professional membership dues and annual licensure fees (case\-by\-case), FE/EIT and PE exam fee reimbursement, and access to HSA, FSA, EAP, and CalPerks resources. Most benefits begin the first of the month following an initial 90\-day introductory period.

This is a hands\-on, multi\-brand position. You will be responsible for developing and managing social media strategies, creating content, coordinating UGC and creator content, building online communities, identifying trends, and using performance data to improve results across multiple brands.

* Develop creative concepts, hooks, captions, CTAs, and content briefs.

* Support product launches, promotions, campaigns, and new brand initiatives.

* Identify high\-performing content and develop additional concepts based on results.
* Test different hooks, creative formats, messaging, and content strategies.
* Ensure each brand maintains its own voice, positioning, and visual identity.
* Stay current with supplement, wellness, beauty, lifestyle, and DTC social trends.

**Qualifications**

* 3\+ years of professional social media management experience.
* Experience managing **multiple brands or accounts at the same time**.
* Experience with consumer products, preferably **dietary supplements, health, wellness, beauty, or DTC brands**.
* Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube.
* Strong short\-form video and content development experience.
* Excellent writing and communication skills.
* Experience working with UGC creators and influencers.
* Strong understanding of social media trends and platform algorithms.
* Ability to write compelling hooks, captions, and calls to action.
* Comfortable reviewing analytics and using data to improve performance.
* Highly organized with excellent project management skills.

**Social Media Management \| Multi\-Brand Management \| TikTok \| Instagram \| YouTube \| Short\-Form Video \| UGC \| Influencer Marketing \| Affiliate Marketing \| Content Strategy \| Copywriting \| Community Management \| Social Analytics \| Social Commerce \| Trend Research**

jobs.description:
**Benefits:**
* Health insurance
* Opportunity for advancement
* Paid time off
* Company parties
* Dental insurance
**WHO WE ARE:**  

We are an end\-to\-end Renewable Energy provider. We offer products to commercial and enterprise clients in EV Charging solutions, Fleet Electrification, Solar Micro\-grids, Energy storage, Hydroponic farming and Rain Water/Grey Water collection systems. We have been experiencing tremendous growth in all these areas and operate under several government rebate programs that ensure a steady and reliable flow of revenues. Our company handles the entire flow of providing these products and services beginning with Sales, Provisioning, Design and Engineering, Contracting and Construction, Servicing and Maintenance. If you are passionate about the EV industry and working with awesome teams in a fast\-growing company, we want to speak with you! Join us in making a meaningful impact!  

**Job Summary**  

This role entails making cold calls and sales calls to prospects across 4 states to sell them on our EV charging products while clearly articulating the incentives, rebates, and revenues for these products. Candidates must be able to fully comprehend a rather complicated business model and articulate it effectively to the prospect, and then work with internal tools to provide proposals, contracts, case studies, model scenarios, etc. This is an hourly role with commission.  

**Responsibilities**  

* Generate and qualify new sales opportunities by conducting high\-volume cold calls, outbound sales calls, direct marketing activities, and market research to identify potential clients within the EV charging and renewable energy industries.
* Engage with prospective and existing clients by understanding their needs, clearly communicating the benefits of our products and services, and demonstrating how our solutions can address their specific business needs.
* Present and promote company products and services through phone calls, electronic communication, in\-person meetings, sales presentations, promotional materials, and other sales activities.
* Develop sales opportunities from initial contact through close by conducting follow\-ups, developing sales proposals, preparing and presenting contracts, negotiating with clients, and responding to sales inquiries and concerns.
* Maintain accurate customer and sales information by keeping customer databases and sales activity records up to date, documenting calls and sales activity, preparing sales reports, and monitoring follow\-up activities for management.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships by providing responsive customer service, taking incoming customer calls, following up on sales activity, addressing customer concerns, and ensuring overall customer satisfaction.
* Support sales and customer education efforts by developing and maintaining sales and promotional materials, conducting product training, and providing relevant case studies, model scenarios, and other supporting information to prospective clients.
* Develop new business through referrals and networking by sourcing client referrals, participating in sales events, and identifying additional opportunities to expand the company's customer base.
* Support market and competitive research by monitoring competitors, market conditions, product development, and industry trends, as well as conducting market research and surveys.
* Perform quality and sales activity follow\-up by monitoring product and service delivery, conducting quality checks, and reporting sales activities, customer feedback, and follow\-up needs to management.

**Requirements**  

* High school diploma required; BA/BS is a plus.
* 3\-5 years of experience as a Telemarketer.
* Superb communication and customer service skills, including the ability to remain calm under pressure.
* Excellent multitasking skills.
* Comfortable making cold calls to potential clients.
* A goal\-driven, results\-oriented mindset.
* Working knowledge of computer software, including Microsoft Office Suite.
* Knowledge of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT.

**Note:** This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - West Coast Based
jobs.description:
**The Company**  

  

Everflow is a SaaS Partner Marketing platform for managing and scaling revenue from affiliates, partnerships, and marketing channels.


Founded in 2016 by industry veterans, we are based in Oakland, Montreal and Amsterdam with a distributed team across the NAM and EMEA regions.  

We’re a bootstrapped company (over $30M ARR) that has grown through supporting happy customers that refer business to us and create word\-of\-mouth excitement. We’re the go\-to platform for brands, agencies, and networks, with 1,000\+ customers including Mutual of Omaha, ClassPass, and Tapjoy.###### **We are accepting applications from candidates that reside in the following areas:**

* California Bay Area \- 2 day in\-office requirement in Downtown Oakland
* LA/OC Area \- 2 Day in\-office requirement in Costa Mesa  

***the in\-office requirement is non\-negotiable***

###### **About the Role**


We are seeking a resourceful and intuitive Business Development Representative who thrives on turning complex challenges into opportunities for connection and growth. You’ll be on the ground floor of a cutting edge company disrupting the multi\-billion dollar ad industry.


As a Business Development Representative, you’ll get exposure to all types of businesses while speaking to stakeholders from ad operations to CEOs. Through a consultative and analytical approach, you’ll be able to help identify real business needs and how Everflow can help them grow.

###### **Full Interview Process:**

* Resume Review
* Recruiter Screen (30 min Zoom)
* Hiring Manager Screen (45 min Zoom)
* In\-Person Interview (up to 1 hour, with a senior member of the Sales Team, location dependent)
* Values Alignment Interview (30 min Zoom)
* References / Offer

###### **Responsibilities:**

* Educate marketing professionals on how Everflow can help them streamline processes and grow their partner marketing program
* Diligently update Hubspot, our CRM, to stay current on leads and follow ups
* Qualify all sales leads and set appointments via chat, email and phone
* Source new sales opportunities through outbound calls and marketing efforts
* Hand off qualified leads to our Account Executives
* Exhibit superior customer service in all prospect/customer engagement
* Shadow our Account Executives to help acquire skills you’ll need for your next role on the Everflow Sales Team

###### **Qualifications:**


While none of these requirements/qualifications are mandatory for hiring, candidates should demonstrate proficiency in some of these areas. As employees advance in their roles, they are anticipated to cultivate deeper expertise across all of these domains.

* Excellent communication and negotiation skills
* Experience with Hubspot is preferred but not required
* Affiliate Networking experience
* Affiliate Marketing Knowledge

###### **Requirements:**

* 1 years of experience as a SDR/BDR/LDR or similar experience
* Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in Business Administration, Communications, Economics, or other relevant field
* Prior experience and strong level of comfort with Linkedin and email outreach REQUIRED
* High energy, intelligent, driven, eager to learn, and committed to overachievement in all challenges you tackle
* Tech\-savvy, ability to problem solve within the tools you are working in
* Self\-starter with strong work ethic and drive to succeed
* Self\-sufficient
* Ability to thrive in a task and goal\-driven sales environment
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
* A can\-do attitude

###### **Compensation**


Annual Base Salary: $60,000 \- $70,000  

Uncapped Bonus Potential

###### **Perks include:**

* Employer Covered Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Unlimited PTO
* Paid parental leave for putting your family first
* Startup\-like environment, without the constant rush to raise the next round of funding
* A very collaborative team and culture
* Education, gym, and equipment stipend

### **Join Our Exceptional Team**


Dive into a role where respect, ownership, and mindfulness define our culture. As a valued team member, you'll enjoy the freedom to innovate and excel, supported by the tools and equipment you need to succeed.### **Balance, Growth, and Connection**

**Work/Life Harmony:** Embrace unlimited PTO and a healthy balance that respects your life outside work.**Continuous Growth:** Regular feedback and discussions about your career path keep you moving forward.**Inclusive Community:** Be part of a welcoming, engaging workplace that celebrates diversity and fun. **We offer a dynamic environment where excellence is rewarded, your well\-being is a priority, and every day brings a chance to make meaningful connections. Ready for a truly rewarding challenge? We're excited to meet you.**

Corn Next is developing CN\-17, a natural material made from corn starch using water and enzymes. We are looking for a dependable, curious Business Development Assistant to help turn promising conversations with universities, government organizations, and strategic partners into well\-organized next steps.

* Keep contact records and project trackers accurate, and make sure agreed actions are completed on time.
* Work closely with company leadership and technical colleagues to understand Corn Next’s material, products, and development priorities.

What we’re looking for

* Excellent written and spoken English, including the ability to independently write clear, professional emails.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and consistent follow\-through.
* A willingness to learn unfamiliar topics, ask thoughtful questions, and take ownership of assigned work.
* Comfort with online research, spreadsheets, shared documents, and contact management tools.
* A bachelor’s degree is preferred. Relevant internship, project, or work experience is welcome.
* Chinese language skills are a plus.

Experience working with universities, public agencies, grants, procurement, or business partnerships is helpful but not required. We value reliability, initiative, and the ability to learn.

Pay: $43,000\.00 \- $58,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

Make a meaningful difference to patients around the world. Driven by a passion to help patients live healthier and more productive lives, our Sales teams embrace Edwards Lifesciences’ values to build trusting, lasting relationships with medical professionals and industry partners. Your insight and dedication will help deepen and broaden clinical knowledge of our company’s innovative technologies, while creating connections between providers and teams across our businesses to ensure patients receive the highest quality of care.

It’s our driving force to help patients live longer and healthier lives. Join us and be part of our inspiring journey.  



  

This is an exciting opportunity for a dynamic **Executive Assistant** to join our Surgical Structural Heart business unit, providing high\-level executive partnership to the Senior Vice President of Sales and the Sales Leadership Team.

* Use all computer programs relevant to the position to support development of correspondence, presentations, such as tracking and charting metrics data, and to perform data entry and report generation in support of a department, significant organizational group, or executive level management
* Ensure the preparation of information, documents, and logistics for assigned department, significant organizational group, or executive level management Perform general administrative activities including screening and directing phone calls, filing as well as composing and typing general correspondence under limited direction
* Schedule domestic and international travel in compliance with existing policies and procedures, to optimize use of Executive's time and schedule
* Plan and execute meetings and events with some supervision
* Other incidental duties

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

  

* Experience working within the healthcare or medical device industry
* Excellent written and verbal communications skills, including negotiating and relationship management skills
* Ability to manage complex travel arrangements, in keeping with overall time commitments and in support of optimizing time management
* Ability to travel up to 10%
* Extensive knowledge and understanding of Edwards policies, procedures, and administrative requirements
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

With a legacy spanning four decades, Action Property Management has become the premier choice for homeowner’s association management. Founded in 1984, Action began with a single client and a vision to elevate ethical and professional standards in the HOA industry. Our unwavering commitment to integrity, and professionalism coupled with our core values of excellence, innovation and care for people, continues to define us. Today, as the largest privately owned HOA management company in the West, we proudly serve over 300 communities across 9 offices. Our success is fueled by a team of nearly 900 dedicated team members who genuinely love what they do and are dedicated to helping homeowners thrive and love where they live.



Action Property Management seeks a **Part\-time Sales \& Marketing Assistant** for our **Corporate Office** located in **Irvine, CA.**


**Job Summary**

The Sales \& Marketing Assistant supports Action’s business development and marketing efforts through prospect research, email outreach preparation, content organization, and project coordination. This part\-time role is well suited to someone who enjoys independent, detail\-oriented work and can keep several ongoing projects organized.


**Compensation:** $22 per hour


**Schedule:** Varies; up to 20 hours per week. Remote position.



### **What You’ll Do (Job Duties)**

**Business Development Research \& Outreach**


* Support business development initiatives through market research, prospect identification, and lead development across Action’s service areas.
* Maintain and organize prospect data, outreach activity, and pipeline\-related information to support ongoing sales efforts.
* Assist with targeted outreach strategies and communications for prospective clients and key market segments.
* Research emerging business opportunities, including new developments, self\-managed communities, and changes within the competitive landscape.
* Support New Business Development managers with research, proposal resources, RFP materials, and tools designed to improve efficiency and consistency.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of business development processes, resources, and technology\-assisted solutions.

  


**Marketing \& Content Support**


* Support ongoing marketing initiatives, brand reputation efforts, and content management across digital and internal platforms.
* Help maintain accurate, current marketing materials and community\-related content as Action’s portfolio evolves.
* Organize and maintain marketing assets, photography, content libraries, and related resources.
* Assist with content development, video support, and other creative marketing needs.
* Support podcast, educational, and accreditation\-related marketing initiatives.
* Coordinate branded promotional materials and other resources used to support marketing, sales, and client engagement efforts.
* Collaborate with the marketing and business development teams on special projects and department priorities as needed.
### **Who You Are (Skills/Experience)**


* High school diploma or equivalent required. A college degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field is preferred. Current college students are encouraged to apply.
* Must be able to successfully pass a background check and drug screen
* Strong research, organization, and data\-entry skills, with close attention to detail.
* Clear, professional writing skills and the ability to adapt messaging for different audiences.
* Ability to manage recurring tasks and longer\-term projects independently.
* Comfort working with spreadsheets, shared content libraries, and email marketing platforms; ActiveCampaign experience is a plus.
* Familiarity with AI tools for research or drafting, with the judgment to verify information before use.
* Experience in marketing, sales support, business development, or the community association industry is helpful.
* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Capable of lifting up to 25 pounds as needed.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator - Cardiology
jobs.description:
The Department of Medicine, Division of Cardiology has developed a clinical research infrastructure within the Division. The goals are to increase industry\-sponsored research, create a system that will assist a physician within the division to operationalize an investigator\-initiated study, and to develop a general cardiology cohort study. The purpose of this position is to carry out the needed tasks as a part of ongoing and future clinical and translational research projects in the Division of Cardiology.

  

Under the supervision of the Clinical Research Supervisor, the Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will perform duties related to the support and coordination of clinical studies, and may receive training and development to prepare and advance to the next level within the series.

  

CRC duties may include, but will not be limited to, support the management of and coordinate the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; help to coordinate staff work schedules to ensure proper coverage; assist with training of Assistant CRCs, and assist Clinical Research Supervisor and/or PI with oversight of other research staff; manage PI’s protocols in the Committee on Human Research online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval and University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.

  

The Department of Medicine, Division of Cardiology has established a comprehensive, multi\-layered clinical research infrastructure to support and expand the Division’s research mission. This infrastructure supports industry\-sponsored research, facilitates investigator\-initiated studies, and advances a general cardiology cohort study, while offering clear opportunities for professional growth in clinical research operations and leadership.

  

The Cardiology Clinical Research Unit (CCRU) supports 100\-120 active clinical trials. The CCRU research portfolio covers phase I\- IV and post approval trial types and covers a diversity of trials ranging from pharmaceutical, device, preventative, and social behavioral research. Within the Division are sub\-specialty sections for: Adult Congenital Heart Disease; Advanced Heart Failure, Transplant, and Pulmonary Hypertension; Cardiac Electrophysiology; Critical Care Cardiology; Cardio\-Oncology and Immunology; Echocardiography and Cardiac Imaging; General Cardiology, Interventional Cardiology; and Prevention. The Division runs several clinical practices in multiple sites, conducts basic and clinical research, and educates medical students, residents, clinical fellows through ACGME as well as non\-ACGME training programs. In addition, the Division has significant and complex financial and administrative relationships with the Department of Medicine (DOM) and the UCSF Medical Center, as well as large patient care programs in the sections noted above, large clinical, Federal, and privately supported research programs and six faculty laboratories. The Division has 90 full\-time faculty, several non\-faculty academics, 36 clinical fellows, several post\-doctoral research fellows, and approximately 60 research support and administrative staff. The Division currently expends over $22 million per year in pursuit of its clinical, research, training, and service missions. While the Division is primarily split between the Parnassus and Mission Bay campuses, clinical fellows have rotations at the Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital and the San Francisco Veterans Affairs Medical Center.


  
Required Qualifications


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience/training
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members, other departments and outside institutions; and the ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment while working with a diverse subject population
* Ability to work well independently, complete projects in a timely manner, and prioritize multiple projects to ensure the completion of essential tasks by deadlines
* Demonstrated ability to exercise tact and discretion in sensitive communications with patients and others. Demonstrated ability in handling a variety of confidential information appropriately.
* Demonstrated positive interpersonal skills and problem solving abilities
* Willing to travel (limited travel for investigator meetings)
  

Preferred Qualifications:


* Two\-year commitment
* Experience in clinical cardiology and clinical/cardiovascular research
* Science, research, or medical background
* Applied knowledge in drug and/or device trials

* Understanding of patient population to create rapport, while also giving insight to what is realistic and appropriate for patient participation
* In\-depth knowledge of ICH/GCP and FDA requirements for INDs, IDEs, and NDAs

* Knowledge of biospecimen collection, processi

**Marketing Assistant**

  

Founded in 2008, Tutu School is a quaint and whimsical collection of boutique ballet schools designed to foster creativity and joy while encouraging tiny dancers to fully exercise their imagination as well as bodies. **Hadrian \- Manufacturing the Future**
=======================================


Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full\-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission\-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

  

Following our $1\.37B Series D at a $7\.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory\-as\-a\-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

  

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

  

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**The Role**
------------


Hadrian is hiring an Experiential Marketing Manager to own every moment where someone meets Hadrian in person. This is the single owner of our events portfolio, from a twelve\-person dinner in a private room to a flagship launch built around a working factory floor.


This role exists because physical experience is our highest\-conviction channel. The people we most want to reach, the engineers building autonomous systems and the machinists and technicians who run them, do not decide where to spend the next five years of their career because of an ad. They decide after they walk a floor, put their hands on a part, and talk to the people doing the work. Your job is to engineer that encounter and then run it at scale across multiple cities.


You will inherit a portfolio that is already in motion and under\-resourced, and you will own it end to end: strategy, calendar, budget, vendors, production, staffing, and the follow\-through that turns a good night into a hire or a customer conversation. This is a builder role with real budget and real autonomy, not a coordinator role executing someone else’s brief.

**Why Now**
-----------


We are scaling our manufacturing footprint across multiple sites and hiring aggressively into the Bay Area and beyond, and our events calendar is about to go from occasional to continuous. Several things are already live: recruiting\-driven dinners and socials, a multi\-month brand and talent campaign anchored in the Bay Area, and a set of factory and site moments tied to new capability launches. The next twelve months include a flagship culminating event whose format is still being decided. You will have a direct hand in that decision rather than inheriting it.

**Own the portfolio**

* Build the portfolio strategy: decide what we show up to, what we build ourselves, what we sponsor, and what we decline, and be able to defend each call on audience and cost.
* Own the events budget, including vendor selection, negotiation, production spend, and reconciliation. Bring a point of view on where a dollar buys more experience.

**Build the flagship moments**

* Lead production on flagship brand and launch events, including the format decision, venue and site selection, run of show, talent and speaker logistics, and executive prep.
* Design factory and site experiences that let people see the machines and the work. Partner closely with site leadership and operations so that hosting visitors never compromises production, safety, or export\-control obligations.
* Sequence events against the broader campaign calendar, including out of home, content, and media moments, so that a launch reads as one connected push rather than several unrelated dates.

**Run the recruiting engine in person**

* Build a repeatable cadence of recruiting\-driven experiences: curated dinners and salons, technical talks and demo nights, happy hours near our sites, and targeted socials for specific engineering and skilled\-trade audiences.
* Partner with talent brand and recruiting on invite strategy, guest curation, and the handoff that turns an attendee into a pipeline candidate. Attendance is not the metric. Conversations and hires are.
* Develop formats that travel, so a dinner series or demo night can run in a new city without rebuilding it from scratch each time.

**Operate and measure**

* Stand up the operating infrastructure this function currently lacks: a single source\-of\-truth events calendar, briefing and run\-of\-show templates, vendor roster, budget tracker, and post\-event debriefs.
* Define what success means per event type before the event happens, then report honestly against it, including when something did not work.
* Manage agencies, production partners, and contract staff. Hold them to a standard and replace them when they miss it.

**Partner across the company**

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. Chronosphere is looking for a hardworking, motivated individual with a closer mentality to join our sales team as an Enterprise Account Executive. You will be responsible for finding, managing and closing new business for both large Enterprises and growing tech companies.

**Qualifications**

* 4\+ years of relevant SaaS selling experience
* Proven success selling a complex technical solution to Enterprise customers
* Experience closing new logos
* Proven track record consistently meeting quota quarter over quarter

* A passion for building relationships and driving business
* A growth mentality with the instinct to be creative
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal \& written skills
* Ability to successfully manage multiple priorities, while maintaining a high sense of urgency
* Organizational skills and a results\-oriented, self\-starter attitude

$272,000\.00 \- $374,000\.00/yr

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

**Company Description**  

XP Power is a fast\-growing company listed on the London Stock Exchange (Ticker XPP.L). We are a factory\-direct power supplies manufacturer with facilities in Malaysia, Vietnam and the USA. We are proud of our culture, which values Customer Focus, Flexibility, Knowledge, Speed and Integrity.


We are seeking a highly organized and customer\-focused candidate to join our friendly and supportive sales organization as a Senior Customer Experience Manager at our corporate office in San Jose, California.


The Senior Customer Experience Manager will be part of a broader team supporting one of XP Power’s key accounts, a leading global technology and semiconductor company. This role partners closely with Field Sales and cross\-functional teams, including Engineering, Quality, Production, Accounting and Shipping, to deliver responsive, high\-quality service. The ideal candidate brings strong organizational skills, semiconductor industry experience, and the ability to support complex customer programs such as consignment, inventory management or similar account support models.

 **Job Description**  

Serve as a primary customer support contact for assigned key account, ensuring timely and professional responses to customer inquiries, RFQs, order updates and service/RMA requests


Partner with Field Sales to support customer relationships, identify account needs and help drive opportunities through the sales and order process


Manage quotes, order entry, open orders, customer requests and returns using SAP and other internal systems


Support consignment, inventory management or similar customer programs, including coordinating customer pull signals, tracking on\-hand inventory, monitoring min/max or safety stock levels, reconciling consumption activity, supporting replenishment requirements and communicating program updates to internal and external stakeholders


Maintain accurate customer information, forecasts and account activity in Salesforce and related business tools


Work closely with Engineering, Quality, Production, Accounting, Shipping and other departments to ensure customer needs are addressed accurately and on time


Prioritize multiple customer requests in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining professionalism, composure and attention to detail


Perform other duties as assigned

 **Qualifications**  

Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and customer requests


Experience supporting customers in the semiconductor industry or a similar technical/manufacturing environment strongly preferred


Experience with consignment, inventory management, customer portals or similar key\-account support programs preferred, such as managing customer\-owned inventory, coordinating replenishment, reviewing usage or consumption reports, supporting forecast\-driven stocking programs and resolving discrepancies between customer demand, inventory and shipments


Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with customers and internal stakeholders


Strong problem\-solving skills and sound judgment when resolving customer issues or escalating concerns


Team player with a collaborative mindset and willingness to support the broader sales and customer experience team


Ability to remain composed under pressure, manage stressful situations professionally and quickly recover from setbacks


Self\-motivated, proactive and able to thrive in a fast\-paced business environment


Experience with SAP and Salesforce preferred, but not required


Proficient in Microsoft Office with the ability to learn and adapt to new software tools


Experience working with customer portals preferred, but not required

 **Additional Information**  

XP Power provides a safe and healthy working environment that is stimulating and collaborative, where employees are empowered to make a real difference. We place our people at the heart of everything we do. We understand that if we provide our people with the ultimate experience, they will provide the ultimate experience to our customers.

jobs.description:
**Description**


The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self\-motivated, results\-oriented, and collaborative.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customers and accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross\-functional discipline is critical. Cross\-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision\-making.
* Demonstrate account\-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.).
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3\+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2\+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor\-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top\-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical \& analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.

  

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $120,000 to $130,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Our ability to collaborate and problem\-solve makes a difference in patients’ lives daily. By joining one of our account management teams, you will partner with industry experts and be empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy needed to successfully navigate the complex market access landscape. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*


At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality\-of\-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.
