jobs.title: Pharmaceutical Field Sales Representative - San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
**Field Sales Representative**
------------------------------

 **Amplity has partnered with one of our leading pharmaceutical clients for an exciting direct hire placement opportunity.**

### **Position Summary**


The Field Sales Representative is responsible for driving sales performance and achieving business objectives within an assigned territory by effectively promoting and educating healthcare professionals on approved products. This role requires the ability to build trusted relationships with physicians, healthcare providers, pharmacies, clinics, hospitals, and other key customer accounts through compliant, customer\-focused interactions.


The representative utilizes strategic territory planning, clinical knowledge, and consultative selling skills to deliver impactful product presentations, identify customer needs, and implement targeted business plans that contribute to market share growth. Success in this role requires strong analytical capabilities, sound business acumen, effective communication skills, and a commitment to compliance with all company policies and industry regulations.


This position requires up to 50% travel, including occasional overnight travel and periodic weekend participation in patient support programs or company\-sponsored events.


The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is **$80,000 to $95,000**. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, education, geographic location, and overall qualifications.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Territory Management and Sales Execution (60%)**

* Achieve and exceed sales goals and key performance metrics within the assigned territory through effective business planning and execution.
* Develop and maintain strategic territory plans that maximize customer engagement and business opportunities.
* Deliver balanced, accurate, and compliant product presentations using approved promotional materials.
* Establish and maintain productive relationships with healthcare providers and key stakeholders.
* Execute targeted call plans and maintain appropriate call frequency based on customer segmentation and business objectives.
* Identify opportunities to expand product utilization while addressing customer needs and clinical considerations.
* Manage and document product sample distribution in compliance with Company policy and Prescription Drug Marketing Act (PDMA) requirements.
* Maintain accurate customer records, territory information, and sales activity documentation.
* Utilize all approved sales and marketing resources to communicate product value and support customer decision\-making.

### **Product Expertise and Customer Engagement (20%)**

* Develop and maintain comprehensive knowledge of assigned therapeutic areas, disease states, and product indications.
* Apply the Company's sales methodology, including DiSC communication principles, to effectively engage diverse customer personalities and practice settings.
* Conduct pre\-call planning and post\-call analysis to optimize customer interactions and improve outcomes.
* Analyze territory performance data, account insights, and sales reports to identify trends and opportunities.
* Leverage approved business development resources and promotional budgets to maximize territory performance.

### **Administrative and Compliance Responsibilities (20%)**

* Complete expense reports, call reporting, and other administrative requirements accurately and on time.
* Document customer interactions and sales activities promptly within the Veeva CRM system.
* Monitor and respond to company communications and email correspondence daily.
* Ensure proper care, maintenance, and security of company\-issued equipment, including laptops, tablets, mobile devices, and fleet vehicles.
* Maintain compliance with all company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards.

**Additional Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

* Adhere to all corporate compliance policies, procedures, and ethical standards.
* Participate in sales meetings, training programs, conference calls, and professional development activities.
* Support patient\-focused programs and initiatives as needed.
* Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.
* Demonstrate professionalism, accountability, and commitment to organizational values.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

### **Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, Healthcare, or a related required.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

### **Experience**

**Required**

* Minimum of one (1\) year of healthcare, medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences sales experience.

**Preferred**

* Pharmaceutical sales experience.
* Specialty pharmacy experience.
* Experience supporting limited distribution products.
* Experience calling on specialty physicians and healthcare providers.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies**
---------------------------------------

### **Sales \& Business Skills**

* Consultative selling techniques
* Territory and business planning
* Customer relationship management
* Account management
* Influencing and negotiation skills
* Sales presentation and communication skills
* Business acumen and market analysis
* Direct selling experience

### **Technical Skills**

* CRM systems, preferably Veeva or Salesforce
* Microsoft Office Suite
* Data analysis and reporting tools
* Digital selling and virtual engagement platforms

### **Professional Competencies**

* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building abilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Self\-motivation and initiative
* Organizational and time management skills
* Problem\-solving and critical\-thinking abilities
* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Adaptability and resilience
* Accountability and results orientation
* A

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
Unify is building the **first AI\-native outbound platform** where agents and sellers work side by side. We help revenue teams identify buyers already in market, enrich accounts with data from 40\+ sources, and execute personalized, multi\-channel outreach—all from a single AI\-powered workspace.  

  

Trusted by some of the most innovative go\-to\-market teams, Unify enables reps to spend less time on manual work and more time building relationships, delivering up to **90% time savings** on list building and **19% higher output per rep**.  

  

We're building a team of curious, ambitious people who care deeply about craftsmanship, move with urgency, and thrive in fast\-paced environments. If you're excited about shaping the future of AI and building products that redefine how modern revenue teams work, we'd love to meet you.

**About the Role**
------------------


As one of our early Sales Development Representative, you'll be on the forefront of driving Unify’s growth by generating new business opportunities through strategic outreach and engagement. This role is for someone who is hyper focused on delivering results and understands that this often requires constant, independent process innovation. In addition to helping carry out critical business initiatives with the GTM team, you’ll gain a ton of technical exposure working closely with our product \+ engineering team to deliver key market insights/feedback as we rapidly ship new features. Within a small team like ours, every contribution you make has a direct impact on the company's growth trajectory.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Lead Generation:** Proactively identify \& convert new business opportunities through outbound sales activities
* **Qualification:** Engage with prospects to understand their needs and determine fit.
* **Pipeline Management:** Maintain accurate records and prioritize leads in Salesforce.
* **Collaborate:** Work cross\-functionally to build \& execute top of funnel strategy

**You May Be a Good Fit If:**
-----------------------------

* **Experience:** Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and execute across multiple projects.
* **Tech Stack:** Proficiency in Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and other sales engagement tools (not required \- nice to have!)
* **Attitude:** Motivated self\-starter, eager to consistently take on new challenges \& quickly scale their impact over time
* **Excellent Communicator:** Articulates value proposition effectively and deeply understands customer pain points
* **Team Player:** Collaborates seamlessly with sales, growth and operations.
* **Adaptable:** Thrives in a fast\-paced, dynamic startup environment.


Compensation Range: $110K \- $120K

jobs.description:

------------


San Francisco


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Department**
--------------


Sales


**Compensation**
----------------


* $90K – $120K

  
fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high\-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI\-native products.


As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.


**About The Role**
------------------


As an Inbound Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Fal.ai, you’ll be the first point of contact for potential customers exploring how to build and scale their Generative Media initiatives. You’ll qualify inbound leads, uncover customer needs, and collaborate closely with Account Executives to create opportunities that drive Fal’s growth.
  

  

This is an opportunity to directly impact revenue growth at a fast\-moving startup while building foundational skills in AI sales, customer engagement, and go\-to\-market execution.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Qualify inbound leads from marketing campaigns and website inquiries to identify potential customers and new opportunities.
* Perform discovery to understand each prospect’s business goals, media workflows, and AI infrastructure needs.
* Manage all inbound leads from initial contact to sales\-qualified opportunity, maintaining organized and accurate pipeline data.
* Collaborate with Marketing on campaigns to optimize inbound lead generation and conversion rates.
* Become an expert on Fal’s platform capabilities to communicate its value to technical and non\-technical audiences effectively.
* Partner with Account Executives to hand off qualified leads and ensure seamless prospect experiences.
* Track engagement metrics and contribute insights to improve lead quality and targeting.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Job Description**
-------------------


In order to be considered for this position candidate must be serving permanently in the title, or reachable on the civil service list, exam \# 3027\.
  

  

Transportation Planning and Management (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, curb management, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  

  

The Office of Livable Streets (OLS) is tasked with prioritizing strategic planning, community engagement, research, policy, design, implementation, and long\-term management. Their goal is to create streets that are livable, supporting safety, accessibility, inclusion, resiliency, active modes, community cohesion, and economic vitality citywide. Additionally, they aim to enhance New York City's pedestrian, bicycle, and micromobility networks, providing comfortable, connected, green, and reliable transportation options across the five boroughs. They place special emphasis on Priority Investment Areas, mode shift, and reimagining streets. The office also develops innovative new programs, design typologies, project delivery, and analysis tools to meet the demands of a rapidly changing population with evolving needs and technologies.
  

  

The NYC DOT Transportation Planning and Management Division (TPM), OLS is seeking a Street Improvement Project (SIP) Coordinator; SIPs involve the use of the agency’s operations teams to implement rapid and meaningful changes to city streets, including Vision Zero safety projects, bus priority projects, bicycle network projects, pedestrian priority projects, among others. The SIP\-Central team within OLS is responsible for organizing and prioritizing an increasingly complex work program across agency. The SIP\-Central team also analyzes and determines implementation capacities to communicate realistic annual work plans; leads coordination with other agencies; and uses database tracking and improving efficiencies to increase output while advancing project quality.
  

  

Under the direction of the Director of Street Improvement Projects, the selected candidate will provide critical support to the Street Improvement Projects (SIP) program by aligning project implementation schedules with resurfacings, traffic signal construction, state of good repair work, and other programs within and external to DOT. The candidate will be responsible for improving efficiency by coordinating with multiple divisions to inform the sequencing of new Street Improvement Projects and upgrades to existing SIPs; they will work independently and collaboratively and be required to manage and reconcile multiple competing priorities. Responsibilities include identifying project overlaps and conflicts, communicating dynamically with various stakeholders, aligning schedules, and pro\-actively advancing implementation priorities across multiple units and agencies.
  

  

The candidate will streamline project delivery by identifying upcoming SIP locations that either overlap with the agency’s scheduled state of good repair work, or where the physical and fiscal integrity of the project would benefit from a resurfacing. The candidate will strategize, prioritize, and track requests to align resurfacing dates with SIP implementations. Working with the Deputy Director of SIPs, the candidate will also manage upcoming SIP locations with signal construction work that overlaps with scheduled resurfacings to inform signal construction priorities and timelines. The candidate will use the SIP Portal, maps and databases to identify existing SIPs scheduled for resurfacing or refurbishment, coordinate with project managers or their delegates to determine treatment changes or upgrades, and work with the Deputy Director to prioritize updates in the design queue. Candidate will coordinate with the Furniture and Operations Unit to plan for temporary furniture relocations related to resurfacings, liaise with internal and external partners on other agency or city\-wide initiatives, and perform additional tasks related to the assigned role as needs arise.
  

  

The Department of Transportation’s (DOT) mission is to provide for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods in the City of New York and to maintain and enhance the transportation infrastructure crucial to the economic vitality and quality of life of our primary customers, City residents. DOT is an equal opportunity employer, committed to recruiting and maintaining a diverse workforce in an open and inclusive environment.

**Why Join ADAPT?**


It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.


For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.

**SUMMARY**


Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. This role fosters dignity, respect, and learning while helping to create a safe, supportive, and homelike environment. The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill\-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


The duties and responsibilities of the Residential Program Specialist II will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.
* Ensures the safety, health, and well\-being of the people we support at all times.
* Teaches and assists with activities of daily living (ADLs), including self\-help, social, and community living skills.
* Maintains a personalized, homelike, and respectful atmosphere within the residence.
* Participates actively in interdisciplinary treatment plans and implements individualized program goals.
* Documents daily activities, progress notes, incident reports, and other required records accurately and in a timely manner.
* Responds to crisis situations and medical emergencies, including providing first aid and contacting emergency personnel as needed.
* Contacts emergency personnel (police, fire, ambulance) when necessary to ensure safety of the people we support and staff.
* Ensures all actions are conducted in a manner that prevents abuse, neglect, or exploitation, and immediately reports any concerns in accordance with agency policy.
* Follows all OPWDD\-approved behavior management guidelines, including use of approved interventions when required.
* Administers medications as an Approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP), following agency protocols and under nursing supervision.
* Provides transportation for the people we support to program, work, appointments, and recreational activities as needed.
* Assists with meal planning, grocery shopping, and meal preparation to promote nutrition and independence.
* Participates in housekeeping, laundry, and light maintenance tasks to ensure a safe, clean, and supportive environment.
* Attends and participates in staff meetings, trainings, and in\-service sessions to support ongoing development and quality care.
* Promotes dignity, respect, and person\-centered approaches in all interactions with the people we support, families, and staff.
* Maintains confidentiality of all resident information and documentation.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Six months of related experience is preferred but not required.
* Employees must be approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP) at time of hire or within six months of date of hire.
* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
* Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**COMPENSATION:** $19\.62/hour \+ Industry\-Leading Benefits for all full\-time employees.

**At ADAPT, we value diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging.** We strive to ensure that our employees are comfortable bringing their whole, authentic self to work and that the people we support can also be their authentic selves. We value diverse backgrounds, opinions, ideas, and ways of thinking. We aim to build an inclusive and diverse workforce that is empowered and supported with leaders who create diverse and inclusive teams. We continuously seek opportunities for the organization to foster a more positive, respected, united, and collaborative culture.


ADAPT Community Network is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified candidates of diverse ethnic and racial backgrounds and status are encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels.

jobs.title: College Preparatory Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Harlem Children’s Zone (HCZ) — a world\-renowned education and poverty\-fighting organization based in New York — seeks an enthusiastic, dedicated, and mission\-aligned College Preparatory Program Coordinator to support the College Success Office.


The College Success Office (CSO) provides year\-round academic, administrative, and emotional support, as well as financial and career preparation, to participants in HCZ’s Promise Academy high schools and afterschool programs. Our mission is to ensure our participants have the resources and guidance they need to succeed in college and beyond. The main components of the CSO include: scholar outreach, academic support and guidance, financial aid advisement, college transfer assistance, summer and winter internship opportunities, and community building efforts within our program.


We are currently seeking two College Prep Program Coordinators, one for our Promise Academy scholars and another for our Zone After\-School Programs. The College Preparatory Program Coordinators provide leadership, supervision, and strategic oversight for the College Preparatory Program team serving HCZ’s Promise Academy scholars or the team serving our Zone After\-School programs. The Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the successful implementation of college preparation, college access, matriculation, and postsecondary transition programming by supervising a team of College Preparatory Program Counselors and establishing best practices across either Promise Academy or the Zone After\-School programs.


The ideal candidate is an experienced college access professional with demonstrated success in staff supervision, program development, cross\-functional collaboration, and data\-driven decision\-making. This individual will lead initiatives that promote a strong college\-going culture, strengthen scholar and family engagement, and increase postsecondary enrollment and persistence outcomes for HCZ scholars.


For more information, check out **Want to Work at Harlem Children’s Zone? Here’s 7 Things You Need to Know**

 **Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree (master's preferred) in Higher Education, School Counseling, Educational Leadership, Student Affairs, Social Work, or a related field required.
* At least 2\-3\+ years of experience in college admissions, college counseling, student advising, and the use of data\-driven methods to increase scholar admission to and matriculation into college.

**Who you are**

* Knowledge of admissions, enrollment policies, financial aid, and postsecondary education.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to complete tasks accurately and in a timely manner.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Outlook.
* Ability and willingness to work a flexible schedule to accommodate the needs of the program, including evenings, some weekends, and travel as required on weekdays and weekends.

**What you'll do**

* Supervise, coach, and support a team of College Preparatory Program Counselors, and ensure the consistent implementation of college\-preparation services across assigned Zone high school after\-school sites or in collaboration with Promise Academy school leadership.
* Implement college\-preparation strategies, policies, and procedures to support scholar enrollment and success in postsecondary education.
* Provide ongoing training, professional development, and guidance to College Preparatory Program Counselors on college admissions, financial aid, and college counseling best practices.
* Develop and facilitate college\-related classes for scholars during Day School hours.
* Partner with leadership and program staff to support scholars' college planning needs, including college fairs, FAFSA workshops, college signing celebrations, and other college transition initiatives.
* Develop and facilitate workshops for scholars and families on college admissions, financial aid, scholarships, and postsecondary opportunities
* Monitor college application, enrollment, and matriculation data to identify trends and improve program outcomes.
* Coordinate program events, including college fairs, FAFSA workshops, college signing celebrations, and other college transition initiatives.
* Support and maintain partnerships with colleges and universities to expand opportunities for scholars.
* Remain abreast of trends in higher education, college admissions, and financial aid to ensure timely and relevant information is shared with scholars, families, and staff.
* Collaborate with the Evaluation team to track scholar outcomes and assess program effectiveness.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Schedule**

* Monday \- Friday; schedule may vary (e.g., 8 am \- 4 pm or 11 am \- 7 pm) based on scholar and program needs.
* Some weekends and evenings, depending on site needs and events; occasional travels

 **Benefits**  

As a member of the Harlem Children's Zone team, you will join a supportive and inclusive community dedicated to helping children, families — and our staff — thrive. We offer highly competitive salaries, a comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for growth.

***Our exceptional full\-time benefits include:***

* Highly competitive base salaries
* Paid time off
* Employee referral bonus
* Career Advancement
* No\-cost health insurance
* Life Insurance
* Short\-and long\-term disability
* Additional voluntary benefits
* Wellness discounts
* Commuter benefits
* Financial wellness perks
* Additional Benefits (Discounts on flights, hotels, theme parks, concert tickets, and more.)

  

We offer competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. The salary range is $70,000 to $80,000\. To be considered, interested applicants should submit their applications directly through the posting. No telephone inquiries or recruiters, please. Replies will only be sent to qualified applicants. HCZ is an EOE.

evening and weekend work required; additional hours may be pre\-approved by the Senior Program Manager during periods of high delivery demands.

**Position Context**


Edconic is a successful group of education businesses, including Sotheby’s Institute of Art, The School of The New York Times, Manchester City Sports Business School, and Vogue College of Fashion. Its mission is to build compelling education programs in partnership with the world’s best brands. The Pre\-College and Collegiate Division (PCD) supports its expansion and plans for growth by working across schools on the development and delivery of non\-MA programs.


 The Program Coordinator, Collegiate Programs role is integral to the delivery of Collegiate Program within Sotheby’s Institute of Art – New York, Vogue College of Fashion – New York, and School of the New York Times. Sotheby’s Institute of Art, founded by Sotheby’s Auction House in 1969, has pioneered the education of arts professionals and offers a wide range of Masters’ degrees, semester courses, and professional programs. Since 2004, Vogue College of Fashion has been providing students with the knowledge, networks and practical experience to become future leaders in the fashion industry and offers a range of degree and non\-degree programs. School of The New York Times, established in partnership with The New York Times in 2016, provides students with an immersive educational experience rooted in journalism, media, and storytelling. Collegiate (undergraduate) academic courses are validated by the University of Montana.

 The Program Coordinator plays an essential role in the preparation and successful delivery of Collegiate Programs. Reporting to the Senior Program Manager, this role supports the planning, developing, and execution of program delivery and contributing to the overall operations of Collegiate, ensuring a well\-organized program.


The role includes responsibilities such as coordinating co\-curricular activities, onboarding faculty and guest speakers, handling class materials, overseeing logistics, and facilitating communication between staff, faculty, guest speakers and students. The Program Coordinator also supports student needs and assists with general operational tasks throughout the program.


Serving as a primary point of contact for students and course leaders, the Program Coordinator will liaise with internal departments including facilities and IT. They will also work closely with colleagues to provide consistent, high\-quality administrative support to both students and staff.


This is a full\-time position that requires **on\-site support** during program delivery, or as directed by the Senior Program Manager. The role will include some evening and weekend hours, as well as additional duties as required with reasonable notice.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


The Program Coordinator plays a vital role in supporting the planning and delivery of Collegiate programs, ensuring a high\-quality and well\-organized experience for students, faculty, and partners. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* **Program Delivery \& Operations:**  

 Support the coordination and execution of all on\-the\-ground program operations, including scheduling, catering, transportation, classroom logistics, and site visits. Ensure all activities run smoothly and efficiently.
* **Site Visits \& Events Coordination:**  

Organize, book, and track logistics for site visits, co\-curricular activities, and student events. Serve as a chaperone when needed.
* **Classroom \& Materials Management:**  

 Prepare and distribute class materials, supplies, and resources, ensuring all program\-related materials are delivered accurately and on time.
* **Guest Speaker \& Faculty Support:**
	+ Coordinate guest speaker logistics, including onboarding documentation, contracts, payments, scheduling, and technical setup (e.g., Zoom).
	+ Provide ongoing support to faculty and assist with faculty\-related activities and events. Meet with faculty prior to the program to review course content, identify teaching support needs, and confirm classroom requirements.
* **Communication \& Stakeholder Coordination:**  

 Act as a key point of contact for students, faculty, and course leaders. Manage program communications, including monitoring shared inboxes, and facilitating coordination with internal departments (Facilities and IT) and external vendors.
* **Student Support \& Welfare:**  

 Provide day\-to\-day support to students, responding to inquiries and addressing concerns. Monitor student wellbeing and escalate issues as appropriate to senior staff. Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and supportive environment.
* **Administrative \& Financial Support:**  

 Maintain accurate records, track budgets, process invoices, and support financial reporting. Assist with purchasing tickets, supplies, and other program\-related items.
* **Systems \& Data Management:**  

 Maintain student\-facing platforms (e.g., Canvas) with up\-to\-date schedules, course materials, and resources. Track and manage program data using internal systems.

 Support in organizing and delivering virtual and in\-person pre\-program orientations, in\-person orientation sessions, ongoing student engagement

**Inventory Logistics Coordinator****Schedule:** Monday\-Friday, 9am\-5:30pm. Off on Saturday and Sunday.**Who We Are**
ACC is one of the nation’s largest open\-admission animal shelters, whose mission is to End Animal Homelessness in NYC. We touch the lives of nearly 20,000 animals each year. ACC is more than an animal shelter; we are a resource to the community, always seeking ways to keep the human\-animal bond intact. With a 90% placement rate, our progressive, life\-saving initiatives contribute to the successful placement of our animals.  

We strive to find loving homes for homeless and abandoned cats, dogs, guinea pigs and rabbits, both by adopting animals directly to the public and by partnering with more than 200 dedicated animal placement organizations (our New Hope partners). We also help keep NYC communities safe and rescue animals in need, responding to emergencies that involve animals as well as keeping our doors open 24/7 for people and animals in need. **Summary**
The Inventory \& Logistics Coordinator is responsible for the day\-to\-day coordination of inventory, receiving, distribution, transportation, and logistics activities across Animal Care Centers of NYC (ACC). This position ensures that supplies, equipment, donations, and animal care essentials are accurately received, tracked, stored, distributed, and transported between ACC locations and external partners in a timely and organized manner.  

This is a hands\-on, field\-based position requiring frequent travel between ACC locations, headquarters, storage facilities, vendors, donors, and other designated locations. The Coordinator physically handles inventory and equipment, loads and unloads vehicles, and works in warehouse, storage, shelter, office, and outdoor environments. The role requires strong organizational and time\-management skills, attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to drive responsibly and patiently throughout New York City. **Required Qualifications:*** Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in inventory management, logistics, supply chain, warehouse operations, transportation, distribution, procurement, or a related field required.
* Valid driver's license with a clean driving record required.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience handling inventory, warehouse operations, and multi\-site logistics.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and follow established procedures.

jobs.title: Apparel and Promotional Product Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
A to Z Media is seeking a detail\-oriented Apparel \& Promotional Product Development Coordinator. In this role, you will serve as the operational backbone of our merchandise department, executing and tracking product development, logistics, and vendor coordination for a diverse roster of music and brand clients.  

  

This role will focus on the seamless execution of merchandise programs, from initial start to final delivery. This role is ideal for a proactive, highly organized individual with a passion for music who thrives on cross\-functional collaboration, precise timeline management, and hands\-on problem solving.  

  

**What You’ll Do**  

  

**Product Development \& Timeline Tracking**  

  

\- Production Tracking \- manage the day\-to\-day product lifecycle, tracking items through the design, proofing, manufacturing, and final delivery stages  

\- Art Trafficking \- work closely with the internal Art Department to route design assets and proofs, ensuring client approvals are secured and accurate  

\- Schedule Maintenance \- maintain an up\-to\-date production calendar and generate weekly status reports to ensure all open projects stay on schedule  

\- Quality Control \- monitor pre\-production samples for quality issues, coordinate client approvals, and flag any discrepancies immediately  

  

**Vendor \& Sourcing Coordination**  

  

\- Vendor Liaison \- serve as a point of contact for our global vendor network to secure pricing, proofs, production timelines, and shipping methods  

\- Order Administration \- issue accurate Purchase Orders (POs) to vendors, confirm receipt, and monitor vendor portals for completion dates  

\- Sourcing Support \- assist in researching and vetting new vendors and manufacturers to expand apparel and promotional product options  

  

**Client Services \& Communication**  

  

\- Account Management \- maintain regular, clear communication (via email, Slack, Zoom, and phone) with clients, managers, and sales teams regarding job statuses  

\- Asset Creation \- assist in compiling internal pitch decks and monthly recaps showcasing newly developed products  

\- Issue Resolution \- act as a responsive point of contact for client claims, following established procedures to correct production or delivery errors swiftly  

  

**Logistics, Data, \& Order Administration**  

  

\- Database Accuracy \- maintain accurate and real\-time records of milestones, production notes, and shipping details within our custom database  

\- Financial Administration \- generate and issue accurate client invoices upon project completion; coordinate VAT and domestic sales tax billing with the finance team  

\- Inventory \& Warehouse Coordination \- liaise with the warehouse team to coordinate incoming shipments, pickups, physical inventory counts, and product reworks  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

\- Experience \- 2 \- 4 years of relevant experience in product coordination, apparel production, account \- management, or merchandise operations  

\- Industry Knowledge \- direct experience working within an apparel, promotional products, or music merchandise environment is highly preferred  

\- Project Management \- proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment  

\- Communication \- exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both business executives and creative artists/managers  

\- Adaptability \- high comfort level working in a dynamic environment, with a "can\-do" attitude and a knack for proactive problem\-solving  

  

**Key Skill Set**  

  

\- Extreme Attention to Detail \- inherent focus on follow\-through, database accuracy, and order precision  

\- Cross\-Functional Collaboration \- ability to act as a seamless bridge between sales, art, logistics, accounting, and external partners.  

\- Logistical Aptitude \- understanding of shipping, tracking, warehousing, and production workflows  

\- Creative Alignment \- a strong eye for product quality and design, combined with a genuine passion for music culture and artist branding.  

  

Founded in 1994, A to Z Media is a family\-owned company specializing in Vinyl, CD, DVD, Promotional Product and Apparel, and Manufacturing Services. For over 30 years, we have been committed to delivering exceptional customer service, high\-quality products, and competitive pricing for our global clientele. We work closely with clients to provide bespoke manufacturing solutions, including special printing, packaging, production, and logistical support. Our clients range from indie labels and branding agencies to distributors and Fortune 500 companies. At A to Z Media, we pride ourselves on being a true partner in bringing creative visions to life.  

  

Full\-Time, Onsite to Hybrid, $45,000 \- $65,000

jobs.title: Temporary Culinary & Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
***If working for an organization that supports the land and people of Israel excites you, then join us and you needn't wait another minute to change the world!***

  

  

**Position Overview:**


Jewish National Fund\-USA is seeking a Temporary Culinary \& Events Coordinator to prepare and cook food for meetings and events, coordinate JNF House rentals, and support catering and event operations.

  

  

This is a hands\-on role combining food preparation, hospitality, and event coordination. The position requires experience working with kosher food preparation and service requirements, as well as flexibility to support events that may take place during evenings and weekends.

  

  

This temporary, part\-time hourly position is based in our New York City office and is expected to run from October through January, with the possibility of extension based on organizational needs.

  

  

**Job Responsibilities:**


* Prepare, cook, and present food for meetings, staff programs, fundraising events, and other organizational gatherings.
* Coordinate catering and food and beverage needs, including menu planning, purchasing, preparation, staffing, rentals, and event logistics.
* Manage JNF House rentals, including scheduling, client communication, logistics, and on\-site support.
* Serve as a primary on\-site contact for catering and hospitality needs during events.
* Coordinate with Events, Facilities, IT, vendors, and other partners on room setup, A/V, security, technology, and event requirements.
* Prepare catering quotes and support catering and event\-related revenue opportunities.
* Purchase food, beverages, and supplies; maintain inventory and help manage costs.
* Ensure compliance with kosher dietary laws and food preparation requirements, as well as food safety, allergen, health, and licensing requirements.
* Assist with event setup and breakdown.
* Maintain event information in Salesforce and Wrike.
* Support facilities and office operational needs as needed.
* Work evenings, weekends, and occasional travel as required for events and organizational programs.
  

  

**Qualifications:**


* 2–3\+ years of experience in culinary arts, catering, hospitality, food service, event coordination, or a related field.
* Experience preparing and serving food for groups, meetings, or special events.
* Experience coordinating or supporting events from planning through execution.
* Knowledge of and hands\-on experience with kosher food preparation, handling, and service requirements is required.
* Familiarity with kosher kitchens, food sourcing, and maintaining kosher standards during events.
* Strong organizational, customer service, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Knowledge of food safety standards and applicable health regulations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, event\-driven environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with Salesforce, Wrike, Zoom, or similar platforms is a plus.
* Ability to lift and transport food, catering supplies, and event materials.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Food Handler's Certification or equivalent food safety certification.
* Experience in kosher catering, a synagogue, Jewish communal organization, restaurant, hotel, event venue, nonprofit, or similar environment.
* Experience with purchasing, inventory, and food cost management.
  

  

**Physical Requirements:**


* Ability to stand for extended periods while preparing and serving food.
* Ability to lift up to 30 pounds and assist with event setup and breakdown.
* Ability to safely operate standard kitchen and food service equipment.
  

  

**Schedule and Compensation:**


* Part\-time, hourly position with a minimum of 20 hours per week, plus additional hours as needed for scheduled events.
* Schedule will vary based on meetings, catering, rentals, and event needs.
* Evening and weekend availability is required as needed for events.
* Hourly rate: $30–$40 per hour, commensurate with experience and qualifications.
  

  

**WHAT WE DO**


For 125 years, Jewish National Fund\-USA has helped strengthen the land and people of Israel by investing in the communities, infrastructure, and leadership that shape the country's future. Our work is focused on making Israel's North and South places where families can build full, vibrant lives with access to medical care, emergency response, water solutions, parks, playgrounds, jobs, and economic opportunity. Working with our donors and partners, we support underpopulated communities, help attract new residents, improve quality of life, and create the conditions for long\-term growth. Our work reaches beyond projects on the ground. Through education, travel, and leadership opportunities, we connect Americans of all ages to Israel in meaningful and lasting ways. That vision continues with the World Zionist Village in Be'er Sheva, a global center that will bring people together to live, learn, lead, and strengthen the next generation of Zionist leadership. From urgent relief to long\-term transformation, Jewish National Fund\-USA is helping build a stronger future for Israel and creating lasting legacies for generations to come. Learn more at jnf.org.

  



**SINCE 1901, JNF HAS:**


* Planted more than 250 million trees


* Built over 250 reservoirs and dams


* Developed over 250,000 acres of land


* Created more than 2,000 parks


* Provided the infrastructure for over 1,000 communities


* Connected thousands of children and young adults to Israel and their heritage

  



Jewish National Fund prides itself on honoring the pioneers of the past and celebrating their spirit by continuing the pioneering tradition in the areas of technology, environmental progress, community development, water renewal and building the land of Israel for many years to come.

jobs.description:
**Benefits:**

* 401(k) matching
* Flexible schedule
**Marketing Assistant**

  

Founded in 2008, Tutu School is a quaint and whimsical collection of boutique ballet schools designed to foster creativity and joy while encouraging tiny dancers to fully exercise their imagination as well as bodies. With over 100 locations across the U.S. and Canada, Tutu School provides an imaginative curriculum that celebrates the magic of childhood and builds confidence through movement.  

We are Tutu Collective Inc., a proud multi\-unit franchisee of Tutu School. We currently operate 11 Tutu School locations across California, New York and Connecticut. We are hiring for a Marketing Assistant. This position will report directly to the Director of Business Operations.  

**Job Summary**

  

We are looking for a Marketing Assistant who thinks like a marketer and sells like a relationship builder. This role will support local marketing efforts across our regions with a strong focus on events, partnerships, community outreach, and lead generation.  

The goal of this position is not simply to create awareness, but to turn that awareness into action: new families discovering our brand, attending a trial class, and ultimately becoming members of our community.

  

You will be responsible for the full cycle of event and partnership planning, from identifying opportunities and pitching partners to preparing for events, coordinating staffing and logistics, communicating with partners, and following up afterward. You will often be the first interaction a business, organization, influencer, or community partner has with our brand, so professionalism, confidence, and strong communication are essential.

  

This is a highly collaborative role that works closely with our Director of Business Operations, Regional Directors, Social Media Coordinator, Marketing Coordinators, and teaching teams across multiple markets.
  

**Responsibilities**
**Event \& Partnership Marketing**
* Identify and pursue local events, partnership, sponsorship, and community marketing opportunities across our regions.
* Own the full event lifecycle, including research, outreach, pitching, preparation, staffing, execution, communication, and follow\-up.
* Confidently pitch partnerships through email, phone calls, video calls, and in\-person conversations.
* Build and maintain relationships with local businesses, organizations, schools, family\-focused brands, influencers, and community groups.
* Coordinate event logistics, materials, staffing, schedules, promotional assets, and on\-site needs.
* Represent the brand professionally at community events and partnership activations.
* Follow up with event attendees and leads with the goal of driving trial classes, studio visits, and memberships.
* Track partnership and event results and identify opportunities to improve future activations.

**Local Marketing \& Lead Generation**
* Support organic marketing initiatives designed to increase local brand awareness and drive new customer acquisition.
* Help develop creative ways to bring new families into our studios and communities.
* Support promotional campaigns, local outreach, community initiatives, and grassroots marketing efforts.
* Assist with influencer partnerships, collaborations, and local creator activations.
* Develop relationships that create ongoing referral and lead\-generation opportunities.

**Content \& Social Support**
* Work closely with the Social Media Coordinator to support content creation for events, partnerships, and local marketing initiatives.
* Assist with creating simple graphics, promotional materials, Reels, and other marketing content.
* Help capture content at events and partnership activations when needed.
* Maintain brand consistency across communications and marketing materials.
* Canva and Asana experience is a plus.

**Paid Marketing Support**
* While this role is primarily focused on organic and local marketing, you should be comfortable working alongside paid marketing efforts.
* Support paid social, boosted content, and other digital campaigns as needed.
* Understand how organic partnerships and events can complement paid marketing efforts.

**What We're Looking For**
* Strong sales and relationship\-building skills with the confidence to initiate conversations and pitch opportunities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Professional, polished, and comfortable being the first point of contact with a potential partner.
* Experience working with influencers, partnerships, events, community marketing, or business development.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
* Able to manage multiple events, partnerships, and deadlines across different regions.
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
* Comfortable communicating with a wide range of people through email, phone, video calls, and in person.
* Creative and resourceful with the ability to think of new ways to connect with local families and businesses.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, multi\-location environment.
* Strong follow\-through and a proactive approach to communication.
* Experience with Canva and Asana is a plus.
* Comfortable working with social media and creating basic marketing content.
* Experience with paid social or digital advertising is a plus but not required.

**What Success Looks Like**
Success in this role means creating meaningful local connections that turn into measurable business results. You will help us expand our presence in each market, build strong community partnerships, generate new leads, and ultimately drive more families into our studios through trial classes and memberships.  

We are looking for someone who doesn't wait for opportunities to come to them. You see a local business, event, influencer, or organization and think, \\"How could we partner?\\" Then you confidently reach out, build the relationship, and make it happen.

* Full medical, dental, life, and disability insurance plans that can be tailored to you and your family’s specific needs
* Subsidized child care and fertility benefits
* Paid parental leave
* Free health screenings \& rewards for participation in wellness programs
* A comprehensive 401(k) retirement savings program, matched by Power
* Ample paid vacation and holidays
* An employee\-relief fund
* Year\-round events and activities, including an all expenses\-paid music festival in Cancun, Mexico for you and a significant other

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============


Serval is an AI\-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real\-world workflows and execute them end\-to\-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high\-volume, high\-friction operational work across their organizations.  

  

At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production\-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering.  

  

Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving.  

  

We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others.


**Role Overview**
=================


The opportunities that matter most are often the hardest to get in front of. As our Field Marketing Manager, you'll work side by side with Sales to bring field programs to life across segments and help execute account\-based marketing (ABM) plays for our most important accounts. This is a hands\-on role for someone early in their career who's eager to learn fast, get creative, and see their work directly open doors and move deals forward.


You'll get real ownership from day one, plus coaching and room to grow. As our West Coast presence expands, so will your scope, budget, and responsibility.

**Who You Are**
===============

* **Creative and curious.** You see an opening where others see a closed door, and you're always looking for a fresh angle to reach the accounts that matter.
* **Not afraid to try new things.** You'd rather test something bold than default to "the way it's always been done" \- and you learn quickly from what works and what doesn't.
* **A doer.** You're happy to roll up your sleeves: pulling a report, coordinating with a venue, prepping event logistics, or dreaming up an eye\-catching way to grab a prospect's attention.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Help plan and run field marketing experiences \- regional dinners, happy hours, hackathons, and other creative moments \- that connect to active opportunities and target accounts.
* Support ABM programs for key accounts across channels: direct mail, events, digital, gifting, and content.
* Own the logistics and execution of field events end to end: venues, vendors, invites, registration, on\-site coordination, and follow\-up.
* Partner with Sales to understand territory priorities and account dynamics, and make sure every program ties back to pipeline.
* Track program impact \- account engagement, attendance, pilots started, and pipeline influenced \- and share what you're learning.
* Bring ideas to the table. Test new tactics, push boundaries, and help us stand out.

**What You'll Need**
====================

* 1\-2 years of experience in field, event, growth, or ABM marketing (internships and adjacent roles count).
* Familiarity with, or eagerness to quickly learn, tools like Salesforce, HubSpot (or similar), and intent platforms (6sense, Demandbase, or similar).
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail \- you can juggle multiple events and deadlines without dropping the ball.
* Comfort with data: you can pull basic reports, read metrics, and use them to make decisions.
* A collaborative style that earns trust with Sales and marketing teammates quickly.
* Comfortable moving fast, experimenting, and adjusting in real time.
* A creative thinker who can turn a rough goal into a concrete plan and follow through on execution.
* Comfortable with roughly 25% travel, up to 50% seasonally.

**Nice to Have**
================

* Exposure to marketing toward IT, Engineering, or Security audiences.
* Experience supporting events or campaigns in a B2B or startup environment.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Impact**: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company.
* **Growth**: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company.
* **Culture**: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun.


Compensation Range: $125K \- $185K

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**



At Litify, we're powering a new era for the legal industry. Since our founding in 2016, we've helped law firms and corporate legal departments turn operations into impact through our leading AI\-native Platform of Action.



Over 55K legal professionals and 450\+ enterprise clients across plaintiff, insurance defense, immigration, and the Fortune 500 trust Litify to combine cloud\-based technology, configurable AI\-native workflows, agentic AI, and powerful business analytics into one open ecosystem that moves legal teams from systems of record to systems of action.



Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and recognized as an Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 fastest\-growing private company, Litify is at the center of legal innovation. Headquartered in New York, we're building the last legal platform our customers will ever need.


**About the Role**



Events and field programs are one of our biggest pipeline drivers and some of our most powerful brand moments. We want to grow both – more cities, more formats, more ways to get in front of our audience, show up as Litify, and grow the business. We're looking for a Field Marketing Manager who can take a set of field programs and own them – from strategy and planning through execution and follow\-up – and make sure every event looks, feels, and performs like Litify.



You'll work closely with our Senior Field Marketing Manager who leads our events function, and partner with Sales, Customer Success, and the rest of Marketing to put Litify in front of the right audiences. This role fits someone who doesn't need a playbook handed to them – you'll help shape it, run it, and make it better each time.


**What You'll Do:**


* **Plan and run Litify\-hosted field events:** executive dinners, roundtables, happy hours, workshops, and regional roadshows from ideation to execution, with a clear plan for what success looks like
* **Organize and lead trade shows and industry conferences:** from choosing the right activations and sponsorships to booth strategy, the hosted events around each show, and on\-site meetings, making sure we maximize our presence and ROI
* **Treat every event as a brand activation:** partner with our creative team to bring the Litify brand to life, from booth design and on\-site experience to content, giveaways, and every attendee touchpoint
* **Own your program calendar end to end:** budget, venues, vendors, logistics, invites, promotion, on\-site execution, and post\-event follow\-up, including setting targets and measuring business impact
* **Partner closely with Sales on events:** picking the right target markets and accounts, identifying the audience, driving attendance, and turning events into pipeline
* **Support partner and customer events as part of our broader brand and GTM strategy:** building activations that grow these relationships, deliver a great brand experience, and help expand our book of business
* **Track and report on what's working:** attendance, pipeline generated and influenced, and ROI\- and use it to shape what comes next
* **Collaborate with the full marketing team** on pre\- and post\-event strategy, data and analysis, and design, while making sure everything is tracked
* **Travel to events as needed** (roughly 25–30%)


**What You Bring:**


* **3–5 years** **of field or event marketing experience**, ideally in B2B SaaS
* **A track record of owning programs end to end,** not just executing someone else's plan
* **Highly organized, with excellent project management:** you can juggle multiple events, budgets, and deadlines without dropping anything, and you know how to prioritize based on impact and timing
* **A business\-first mindset:** you start with the outcome, design the strategy and experience to deliver it, and always push for what moves the business forward
* **Comfort working with Sales and senior stakeholders**, and confidence in front of customers and executives
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce and event or marketing automation tools (Splash a plus)
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment where priorities can shift
* **Autonomous, driven, and collaborative:** you see what needs to happen, take ownership, and bring people along


**Nice to Have:**


* A strong eye for brand and design – you know what makes an event feel premium and memorable
* Experience marketing to legal, professional services, or enterprise audiences
* Customer marketing or community experience
* Experience with executive\-level events (GCs, managing partners, C\-suite)


**Disclosure:**  

This job is fully remote, with the exception of employees living in New York City and New Jersey**.** Our NYC/NJ employees adhere to our hybrid schedule, which involves working in our Manhattan office 6 days a month.



The estimated base salary pay range for this role is $115,000\-$125,000\. You will also be offered a bonus and benefits.



Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide.



Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.

jobs.title: Fintech Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Client Account Manager – Fixed Income / MBS**

**Location:** New York City – Midtown West  
**Work Schedule:** In\-office 4 days per week  
**Compensation:** Competitive base salary \+ commission  
**Travel:** Required

**About BondXN**

BondXN is transforming how the institutional securitized product markets trade.

Our electronic trading platform brings together buy\-side firms, mortgage originators, and broker dealers to make the trading of Mortgage\-Backed Securities (MBS) and other securitized products more efficient, transparent, and actionable. BondXN enables institutional investors to electronically conduct BWICs, access dealer liquidity, analyze market activity/data, and make better\-informed trading decisions.

We are a growing financial technology company focused on bringing greater efficiency and transparency to one of the world's largest fixed\-income markets.

**The Opportunity**

BondXN is looking for a **Client Account Manager** with at least **2 years of fixed\-income sales experience** to help grow activity and engagement across our existing client base.

This is primarily a **relationship management and account growth role**. Your most important responsibility will be to understand how our clients trade, identify opportunities to increase their use of BondXN, and work closely with them to make BondXN a more integral part of their daily workflow.

You will spend significant time with existing clients—understanding their trading activity, introducing them to additional BondXN features and capabilities, helping them get more value from the platform, and **driving increased trading volume and engagement.**

You will also have the opportunity to support senior salespeople in identifying and developing new prospects.

**What You'll Do**

**Grow Existing Client Relationships**

* Develop strong relationships with traders, portfolio managers, salespeople, and other users at our existing BondXN clients.
* Become deeply familiar with each client's trading workflow and how they use BondXN.
* Identify opportunities to increase the **frequency, breadth, and volume** of client activity.
* Introduce clients to additional BondXN functionality and new product capabilities.
* Encourage broader adoption across desks, traders, products, and trading strategies.
* Monitor client activity and proactively identify accounts where engagement can be increased.
* Work with clients to solve issues that may be preventing greater adoption.
* Become a trusted resource and day\-to\-day point of contact for your accounts.

**Travel and Client Engagement**

* Regularly visit clients throughout the **New York / New Jersey / Connecticut tri\-state area**. Occasional visits to California and other US states as well.
* Attend client meetings, trading\-desk visits, industry conferences, and other market events.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

* **Minimum of 2 years of professional sales experience in fixed income markets.**
* Good understanding of **MBS, mortgage trading, fixed income, or related capital markets**.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to develop genuine, long\-term relationships with clients.
* Strong curiosity about how clients conduct their business and make trading decisions.
* Comfortable speaking with traders and other institutional market professionals.
* Ability to learn a sophisticated financial technology platform quickly.
* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly for client meetings.
* Ability to work **in person in our NYC office at least 4 days per week**.

**Particularly Valuable Experience**

Experience in any of the following would be highly relevant:

* MBS / CMOs / ARMs / ABS / CMBS / RMBS
* Mortgage trading
* Fixed\-income sales
* Securitized products
* Electronic trading platforms

**The Person We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate is:

**Client\-focused.** You genuinely enjoy spending time with clients and understanding their businesses.

**Commercially minded.** You naturally look for ways to turn relationships into increased platform usage and revenue.

**Curious.** You want to understand not just what a client does, but *why* they do it.

**Persistent.** You follow up. You don't let opportunities disappear because someone didn't respond to the first email.

**Credible.** You can sit across from an experienced MBS trader and have an intelligent conversation about their business.

**Entrepreneurial.** We're a growing fintech company, and this role requires someone who is comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Competitive base salary \+ commission
* 401(k)
* Medical and dental insurance
* Paid time off
* Opportunity for significant compensation growth based on performance
* Opportunity to grow into a larger sales/account\-management role as BondXN expands
* **U.S. citizen or green card holder**
* **No visa sponsorship is available, now or in the future, including OPT/CPT**

**Apply**

Please submit your resume and a brief description of your fixed\-income experience and why you are interested in BondXN.

**Employment seekers only. Recruiters, please do not contact this job poster.**

**Do not contact us with unsolicited services or offers.**

Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

 **How this opportunity is different**

* Effective organization and time management skills
* Ability to communicate effectively, orally and in writing

jobs.title: Surety Account Manager II
jobs.description:
Posting Description:

Are you a surety professional who thrives at the intersection of client service, underwriting strategy, and operational execution? Join a high\-performing team and take on a meaningful role managing and delivering surety bond solutions for many clients.

 *This role is hybrid and can be located near an Aon office.*

 **Aon is in the business of better decisions**

  

At Aon, we build decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.


As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

 **What the day will look like**

  

You'll work closely with clients, surety carriers, and internal collaborators to deliver bond programs with accuracy, compliance, and outstanding service. This role involves significant client interaction and ownership of key accounts. It offers the chance to create an immediate impact while further developing your expertise in the specialized field of surety.

  

* Works under minimal supervision, exercising good judgment in routine and moderately complex client and market situations.
* Takes primary accountability in managing selected accounts.
* Possesses a working knowledge of surety bonds, including bond program structures, indemnity concepts, and market practices including accurate client interaction and advisement.
* May assist in onboarding, mentoring, and training internal team.
* Works closely with carriers every day to address evolving needs. Prepares and processes various surety instruments, such as bid, final, miscellaneous, and court bonds. Ensures these align with underwriting guidelines and client expectations.
* Collaborates with clients daily to meet their changing requirements. Implements Consents of Surety, Prequalification Letters, Riders, and other obligations required by clients in line with State rules. Determines the necessary documents to complete issuance, including power\-of\-attorney, resident license, and others, ensuring attention to contractual, legal, and financial details.
* Prepares General Indemnity Agreements and bond applications. Coordinates with and advises clients to acquire complete, accurate financial and corporate information for underwriting review. This includes any other nuanced client needs or requirements.
* Maintains and supports data accuracy and promotes proactive oversight of bond programs in AonBondLink (ABL).
* Works closely with internal collaborators to implement and ensure accurate, complete electronic bond files in AonBondLink (ABL). Also confirms and manages related client financial and underwriting records while following internal controls and audit requirements to prevent E\&O.
* Manages countersignature requirements and related jurisdictional nuances to support compliant bond issuance across multiple states and territories.
* Provides technical surety mentorship and support to non\-surety colleagues, helping interpret bond forms, indemnity requirements, and program structures for internal collaborators.
* Coordinates receipt and organization of pertinent client related underwriting information (e.g., financial statements, work\-in\-progress schedules, bank information, organizational documents) to support timely carrier decisions.
* Verifies that all bonds are issued within established surety lines of credit and brokerage authority. Assists in structuring and negotiating approvals for bond requests exceeding standard limits or outside delegated authority.

 **How this opportunity is different**

  

Unlike many surety operations roles focused mainly on transaction processing, this position combines technical surety expertise with client advisory duties and meaningful market involvement. You will work directly with complex bonding programs, underwriting negotiations, and carrier relationships while acting as a trusted resource for clients and internal colleagues. The role also allows for broader influence through mentoring, participation in process improvement, and responsibility for critical compliance and underwriting workflows. For professionals wanting to move beyond administrative bond issuance and act as a strategic partner in the surety process, this is an outstanding chance to increase visibility, expand impact, and grow within a leading organization.

  

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  

* Is able to effectively interpret a variety of technical instructions involving abstract and concrete variables and apply them to client and bond\-specific scenarios.
* Shows excellent organizational, time\-management, and multi\-tasking abilities, successfully managing various client and market requirements.
* Retains Notary Public certification.
* Maintains Power of Attorney appointments with major surety markets and exercises such authority responsibly and in accordance with internal controls.
* Is proficient in all required technology platforms, including AonBondLink, Bridge, and Outlook. Uses them to facilitate deliverables for clients and with markets around exposures, new bond needs, changes, expirations, or similar.

 **Education and licensing requirements:**

* A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred for this position. Maintain Notary Public designation and hold the appropriate Producer license.

**How we support our colleagues**

  



In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working!

  

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn,

The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self\-motivated, results\-oriented, and collaborative.

* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross\-functional discipline is critical. Cross\-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision\-making.

* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3\+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2\+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor\-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top\-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical \& analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
