We’ve reached $10m ARR and raised a $10m Series A to support our growth. As we expand across the UK and North America, we’re looking for a US Account Manager to manage and grow relationships with our local business and property management partners in North America.

**The opportunity**
-------------------


We are expanding our presence across key US college markets. We need a dedicated Account Manager to oversee partner onboarding, maintain strong day\-to\-day relationships, and maximize engagement across both property and perk partners, with a primary emphasis on growing and managing our perk partner network.


You’ll act as the main point of contact for property and perk partners across North America—spanning national brands and local business operators—ensuring smooth onboarding, driving renewal rates, and ensuring partners deliver genuine value and enticing offers to students on the Housr platform.

**Why this role is interesting**
--------------------------------


Our US business is growing quickly, presenting a unique opportunity to shape our partner success playbook across both student housing and perk partnerships as new campus markets come to life.


You’ll work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver seamless onboarding, drive student engagement with partner perks and offers, represent partner feedback internally, and expand revenue across accounts.

**What you’ll own**
-------------------

* End\-to\-end account management, retention, and success for assigned US perk and property partner accounts
* Successful partner onboarding, product adoption, offer setup, and ongoing health tracking across key engagement metrics.
* Regular account reviews and performance reporting on promotional campaigns, offer redemptions, listing activity, and student usage.
* Identifying upsell, cross\-sell, and expanded placement opportunities to grow revenue and partner participation across university markets.
* Gathering feedback from local business owners and national brand partners to influence product strategy and positioning for the US market.
* Collaborating with GTM and marketing teams on joint promotional campaigns, local activations, and ensuring perk offers go live smoothly.
* Managing contract renewals, terms negotiation across structured and local agreements, and maintaining clear records in HubSpot.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* Proven track record in B2B account management, client success, or partner operations managing brand or property accounts.
* Experience working within brand partnerships, local merchant services, proptech, student housing, or SaaS industries.
* Demonstrated ability to retain and expand key accounts while building strong relationships with both local business owners and mid\-market teams.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills with a solution\-oriented mindset.
* Proficiency with CRM tools (such as HubSpot) and analyzing partner usage metrics.
* Self\-starter attitude with the ability to operate effectively in a fast\-growing, multi\-time\-zone environment.

**A real nice to have**
-----------------------

* Direct experience managing perk, brand, or local merchant partnerships in major US college markets.
* Familiarity with launching partner offers in new geographic territories or working with local student\-focused businesses.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* 20 days PTO plus federal holidays
* 100 percent employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision, with options for dependents
* 401(k) match, life, and disability cover
* Front\-row seat to hyper\-growth \- Join a company that has gone from $0 to $10M ARR in 18 months and is just getting started in North America.
* Flexibility \& trust \- We care about outcomes, not clock\-watching. You’ll have the autonomy to do your best work.
* Work with a world\-class, global team \- Collaborate with sharp, driven teammates across the US, UK, and beyond.

**Interview process**
---------------------


We aim to keep the process straightforward and relevant to the role.

* An introductory conversation with our Talent Partner (Matt)
* Video call with our COO (Nick)
* A practical account strategy presentation based on a realistic scenario, shared in advance with our US leadership team
* A final conversation with our Founder \& CEO

  

We’re happy to discuss any adjustments that would help you take part in the process.

jobs.title: Account Manager, GFO
jobs.description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

The Account Manager acts as the day\-to\-day client contact for our family members, family offices and their nominated representatives. They will liaise directly with internal partners to resolve issues and hence will be required to build an effective network throughout the bank to find solutions to issues raised. Working closely with the Relationship Manager they will also help assist in driving growth opportunities and additional business.

  

The GFO team are seeking an enthusiastic, self\-motivated and ambitious individual looking to grow in experience and knowledge alongside the group as we expand our client base in the region.

 **The key responsibilities of the role include:**

* Building trusted client relationships through engagement, effective communication and consistent delivery.
* Responding to client instructions and queries immediately and effectively.
* Independently resolve issues and problems by using your internal network and product knowledge to explain and implement solutions in a timely manner.
* Executes daily client activity, oversees transaction processing, handles inquiry resolution, obtains appropriate documentation, and ensures systems information is up\-to\-date.
* Informing clients of any substantive changes to processes and procedures adopted by Northern Trust.
* Assisting the client to navigate Northern Trust, being a central point of contact for operational matters.
* Facilitate client’s ability to use online NT applications
* Ensures accurate set up and review of fees. Timely and accurate client invoicing and fees collection.
* Proactively work with clients to minimize risk and anticipate needs.
* Escalate client concerns in a timely and accurate manner.
* Follow up with internal parties on any queries/issues which arise from meetings within 24 hours.
* Maintain all documentation/files as appropriate to each client relationship.
* Coordinate all requests from clients with regard to account opening/closing, global markets and authorized signatories.
* Open/ Close accounts.
* Raise requests to remove/ add users for on\-line client system and maintain a list of users.

 **Skills/ Qualifications:**

* A strong background with a good understanding of the global custody industry
* Direct experience in interacting with demanding clients or prospects and meeting their needs
* Excellent organizational skills and comfort in prioritizing competing demands
* An ability to own and resolve problems independently
* Ability to perform under pressure and to be flexible with working when required
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Independent problem resolution
* Time and project management
* Adaptability to work on a wide variety of (occasionally unique) issues


Salary Range:


$67,500 \- 111,500 USD*Salary range is a good faith estimate of base pay. Northern Trust provides a comprehensive benefits package including retirement benefits (401k and pension), health and welfare benefits (medical, dental, vision, spending accounts and disability), paid time off, parental and caregiver leave, life \& accident insurance, and other voluntary and well\-being benefits. Northern Trust also provides a discretionary bonus program that may include an equity component.*

 **Work Authorization**

  

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Northern Trust will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H\-1B, L\-1, TN, O\-1, E\-3, H\-1B1, F\-1, J\-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment\-based visa).  



  

**Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

jobs.title: Cardiovascular Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Description**


The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self\-motivated, results\-oriented, and collaborative.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customers and accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross\-functional discipline is critical. Cross\-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision\-making.
* Demonstrate account\-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.).
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3\+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2\+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor\-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top\-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical \& analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.


The annual base salary for this position ranges from $120,000 to $130,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include a company car or car allowance and eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.

**Why Syneos Health?** Our ability to collaborate and problem\-solve makes a difference in patients’ lives daily. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.

Oracle is seeking a high\-performing Data Platform Account Executive to help Healthcare and Life Sciences organizations transform how they leverage data, analytics, AI, and cloud technologies. This role focuses on strategic enterprise accounts across Providers, Payors, Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, Medical Device, and Research organizations, helping customers modernize data architectures and accelerate business outcomes through Oracle's industry\-leading Data Platform and Cloud portfolio.


If you thrive in complex enterprise sales, enjoy building executive relationships, and have a passion for helping customers solve critical business challenges, we'd love to meet you.


**What You'll Do**

* Develop and grow strategic Healthcare \& Life Sciences accounts.
* Build trusted relationships with C\-level executives and key business stakeholders.
* Drive sales of Oracle's Data Platform, Database, Analytics, AI, and Cloud solutions.
* Lead customer discussions around data modernization, AI adoption, analytics transformation, and digital innovation.
* Position Oracle as a strategic partner for multi\-cloud and hybrid cloud initiatives spanning OCI, AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.

* Collaborate with Oracle's cloud, AI, industry, and solution engineering teams to deliver customer success.

* Experience selling Data Platform, Database, Analytics, AI, Cloud Infrastructure, SaaS, PaaS, or related solutions.
* Healthcare and/or Life Sciences industry experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success selling to CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and other executive stakeholders.

* Familiarity with multi\-cloud strategies involving OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP.

Oracle delivers one of the industry's most complete portfolios across Data, AI, Analytics, Database, and Cloud Infrastructure. Our differentiated multi\-cloud strategy enables customers to innovate without compromise while leveraging the cloud platforms that best fit their business needs.


Join a team that is helping the world's leading healthcare and life sciences organizations unlock the power of data, accelerate AI adoption, and shape the future of their industries.


Apply today and help transform Healthcare through Data, AI, and Multi\-Cloud innovation.

Leverages the Oracle sales model to maximize revenue growth and increase local market share. Builds and expands business partner revenue and self sufficiency.

jobs.title: Technical Sales Representative
jobs.description:
As the industry leader in water technology, we’re growing and need talented people like you to help us continue to protect the world’s most vital resource.

  

Nalco Water, an Ecolab Company, seeks a **Technical Sales Representative** to join its industry leading sales team. You’ll be responsible for revenue and profit growth of programs and services in targeted accounts. Using a consultative sales approach, you’ll build relationships with existing customers by executing system assurance programs that meet their key business needs. With strong account leadership, you’ll also convert strategic competitive accounts and sell new technologies to current customers.

 **What’s in it For You:**

* You’ll join a growth company offering a competitive base salary, bonus structure and benefits
* A company vehicle and cell phone
* A long term, advancing career path in service, sales or management
* Access to the industry’s most innovative training programs
* Support from a dedicated technical service team
* A culture that values safety first, including training and personal protection
* Pride in working for a company that provides clean water, safe food, abundant energy and healthy environments

 **What You Will Do:**

* Generate and execute sales plans in existing customer base and in assigned competitively\-held accounts, to meet profit increase goals.
* Work closely with current and prospective customers to understand business needs and recommend continuous improvement and innovation plans that will maintain and grow sales
* Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders in current and prospective customers, including plant or facility executives
* Provide technical support to customers; identifying and resolving customer challenges, escalating as required
* Engage in problem solving by performing system analysis, interpreting data and providing written recommendations to ensure customer operations are performing at optimal levels.
* Actively sell and support Nalco Water innovations and technology in assigned customers to promote long\-term business relationships with Nalco Water

 **Territory/Location Information:**

* This position is based in **Chicago, IL**
* Territory covers about a **100 mile radius** of the surrounding area
* Targeted accounts are within the institutional industries
* **\<25%** overnight travel required

  

As a trusted partner, your customers will rely on you for their success. Nalco Water is committed to seeing you succeed and provides innovative training programs to ensure you’re prepared to solve any customer problem.

  

Training programs are held in the field and at Nalco Water Headquarters in Naperville, IL; travel is arranged and paid for by Nalco Water. Based on your skill level and experience, topics covered may include technology, product, service, business and industry acumen, direct coaching and mentoring, sales management and leadership, classroom training and certifications.  



  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree
* Technical sales or field sales support experience
* Possess a valid Driver's License and acceptable Motor Vehicle Record
* Immigration sponsorship is not available for this role

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (chemical, mechanical, industrial) or life sciences (biology, chemistry, etc.)
* Water treatment or specialty chemical industry experience
* Working knowledge of OR operations, wet end chemistry, pulp mill operations\>

jobs.description:
Customer Sales Representative

**Chicago Heights, IL \| Full\-Time \| W2**  
**$800–$1,200 Per Week \| Weekly Pay \| Paid Training \| Commission Opportunity**

Good With People? Put That Skill to Work.

Some people are naturally good at talking to others.

They know how to start a conversation, ask the right questions, listen and make complicated choices easier to understand.

If that sounds like you, our client is expanding its customer\-facing sales team in the Chicago Heights, IL market and is hiring a **Customer Sales Representative**.

You'll work face\-to\-face with customers inside established retail partner locations, helping them understand available **services** through our client's campaign.

This is a full\-time position combining **customer service, retail sales, relationship building and account development**.

Previous telecommunications or wireless experience is not required.

**Paid training is provided.**

What You'll Actually Be Doing

This is an active, people\-facing position.

You won't spend your entire day behind a register or sitting at a desk.

Instead, you'll interact directly with customers inside partnered retail locations.

Your responsibilities include:

* Greeting and engaging customers face\-to\-face
* Starting natural, professional conversations with shoppers
* Building rapport and creating a positive customer experience
* Asking questions to understand individual household needs
* Learning about customers' current internet, mobile and connectivity services
* Educating customers on available Spectrum products and services
* Explaining current options, features, pricing and promotions clearly
* Helping customers compare available solutions
* Generating qualified customer interest and sales opportunities
* Recommending services based on individual customer needs
* Answering customer questions
* Guiding interested customers through the enrollment process
* Maintaining accurate customer and account information
* Building relationships throughout the customer experience
* Developing strong working relationships with retail employees and store leadership
* Maintaining current product and promotional knowledge
* Tracking customer interactions and individual sales activity
* Working toward individual and team performance goals
* Participating in ongoing customer service, product and sales training

Great Sales Starts With a Conversation.

We're not looking for someone who can memorize a pitch.

We're looking for someone who can understand a customer.

What are they currently using?

What are they paying for?

How many people and devices are connected in their home?

Are they streaming, gaming or working remotely?

What matters most when they're choosing a service?

You'll learn how to move naturally through:

**Conversation → Discovery → Education → Recommendation → Enrollment**

The goal is to understand first and recommend second.

That's **consultative sales**, and it's a skill that translates far beyond telecommunications.

Compensation$800–$1,200 Per Week

**Weekly Pay \| Full\-Time \| W2 \| Paid Training**

Performance\-based commission opportunities are available.

Actual compensation within the advertised range depends on experience, individual performance and the applicable compensation structure.

Complete compensation details are reviewed during the interview process.

No Telecom Experience? No Problem.

Products can be taught.

We're hiring for the qualities that are harder to teach:

**Communication. Confidence. Reliability. Coachability. Work Ethic.**

You may be a strong fit if you:

* Enjoy meeting and talking with new people
* Can confidently initiate conversations
* Naturally build relationships
* Have strong customer service instincts
* Listen before recommending a solution
* Communicate clearly and professionally
* Enjoy working toward measurable goals
* Are motivated by performance and earning potential
* Take coaching and feedback well
* Are dependable and team\-oriented
* Want opportunities for professional growth
* Are comfortable working in an active retail environment
* Have full\-time availability
* Can work weekends as required by the retail schedule

Your Experience May Be More Relevant Than You Think

You don't need a traditional sales background.

Candidates with experience in the following areas often transition well:

**Customer Service**  Retail **Restaurants**  Serving **Bartending**  Hospitality **Front Desk**  Electronics **Wireless**  Cell Phone Sales **Fitness**  Athletics **Events**  Promotions **Marketing**  Customer Relations **Account Support**  Sales

Recent graduates and entry\-level candidates are encouraged to apply.

Build Skills You Can Actually Use

This position provides hands\-on experience in:

Customer Experience

Learn how to create positive customer interactions and build trust.

Consultative Sales

Develop the ability to identify customer needs before recommending solutions.

Account Development

Understand how product education and customer enrollment contribute to account growth.

Telecommunications

Build working knowledge of internet, mobile, TV and connectivity services.

Communication

Become more confident presenting information and explaining options to different personalities.

Customer Acquisition

Learn how customer engagement develops into new business.

Performance Management

Understand how customer interactions, conversion and individual results contribute to team performance.

Looking for Growth?

For candidates interested in building a career rather than simply finding another job, strong performers may have opportunities to develop additional experience involving:

**New\-Hire Training**  Team Support **Sales Coaching**  Leadership Development **Assistant Management**  Territory Development

Advancement is based on demonstrated performance, reliability, leadership ability and business needs.

375 Beale Street  
San Francisco, CA

Full\-time \& Part\-time

$38\.00\-$48\.00/hour

NTT Broadcast is seeking experienced broadcast and audiovisual professionals to join our on\-site team supporting government meeting operations at 375 Beale Street in San Francisco.

We are interested in professionals whose backgrounds include government, municipal, legislative, public\-access or public\-affairs broadcasting, as well as experienced professionals from corporate broadcasting, corporate television, and professional audiovisual environments.

Our employees work directly with government agency clients and support live public meetings where accuracy, reliability, professionalism, discretion, accountability, and sound judgment are essential.

The Production Coordinator is a seasoned professional with hands\-on broadcast production experience who is capable of directing live government meeting broadcasts while working closely and successfully with government agency clients and other experienced production and technical professionals.

· Coordinating pre\-production, live production, and post\-production activities.

**Veteran's Accession House \| Contra Costa County, CA \| In\-Person \| $55\-$65,000/year**

**Be part of something new**  
Most veterans lost to suicide were never connected to VA care. Nationally, that's an average of 17\.5 veterans every day.\* We're changing that in Contra Costa County, and we need you to help lead the way.

For the first time, our county will have a dedicated program focused on preventing veteran suicide. As our founding Outreach Coordinator, you won't be stepping into a routine role. * Plan and lead outreach events, health fairs, and awareness campaigns

*Teach people how to help*

* Deliver evidence\-based suicide prevention trainings (such as QPR, ASIST, or S.A.V.E.) to diverse audiences
* Create brochures, toolkits, and newsletters that speak to veterans and their communities
* Offer compassionate, non\-clinical support and warm handoffs to crisis services (such as the 988 Suicide \& Crisis Lifeline) when someone needs help

*Measure what matters*

* Track outreach activities and participant data for grant reporting and program evaluation
* Identify gaps and higher\-risk communities through ongoing needs assessments
* Work with the Program Manager and internal team to align outreach with program goals

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in public health, social work, psychology, communications, or a related field, **or** an equivalent combination of education, work, and lived experience
* 2\+ years in community outreach, health education, mental health advocacy, or crisis intervention
* Confident public speaking, whether it's a room of five or five hundred
* A natural relationship\-builder who follows through
* Knowledge of local crisis resources and evidence\-based suicide prevention practices
* Empathy, professionalism, and discretion with sensitive information
* Comfort with office software and data\-tracking tools
* Flexibility for occasional evening and weekend events

**Veterans, military family members, and people with lived experience are strongly encouraged to apply.** Your perspective is an asset here.

**Why Join Us**

* **Impact from day one:** Your work connects veterans to support that can save lives
* **Founding\-team influence:** Shape a brand\-new program from the ground up
* **Pay:** $55,000–$65,000 per year, based on experience

**Ready to help us reach every veteran?**

Pay: $31\.25 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

**TITLE: JOB CODE:**

ABOUT US
  
We practice Beneficial Banking™ by investing in social and environmental impact, prioritizing transparency, and expanding access to equitable financial products, all in pursuit of a banking system that is regenerative for the planet and equitable for all. We bring that same commitment to our people by cultivating a vibrant, inclusive, and purpose\-driven culture where employees are empowered to grow, contribute, and thrive. Together, we strive to make a meaningful difference in the communities where we live and work, creating positive impact through partnership, service, and shared success.
  
  

POSITION OVERVIEW
  
The Treasury \& Client Services Associate (TCSA) provides comprehensive operational and client support to Commercial Banking teams and commercial clients across business, personal, and commercial deposit products. This role serves as a primary point of contact for client servicing inquiries and service requests, delivering timely and professional support through phone, email, and in\-person interactions.
  
The TCSA is responsible for onboarding new client relationships, including collecting and reviewing required documentation, completing account setup, and ensuring accuracy and completeness of all new account records. The role plays a critical part in safeguarding the Bank by applying risk assessment protocols, adhering to regulatory requirements, and ensuring compliance with internal policies and procedures to mitigate operational, reputational, and audit risk.
  
Acting as a subject matter resource, the TCSA maintains working knowledge of deposit products, cash management services, and related systems, including Online Banking, ACH, wire transfers, EFTPS payments, and Remote Deposit Capture. The role supports relationship banking efforts by delivering high\-quality client service, assisting with client onboarding, and identifying potential opportunities to deepen existing .relationships for referral to relationship managers or Treasury Management Advisors.
  
The TCSA collaborates closely with Treasury Management Advisors, Client \& Treasury Managers, and other internal partners to support daily operations and enhance the client experience. This position includes oversight of assigned operational processes and requires strict adherence to compliance standards in all account\-related activities and client communications.
  
This position is represented by a union. Employment in this role is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable collective bargaining agreement, including union membership requirements and/or dues or fees, where applicable.
  
  

ESSENTIAL DUTIES
  
Client Service \& Relationship Support

new_jobs.title: Cardiovascular Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
**Description**


The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self\-motivated, results\-oriented, and collaborative.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customers and accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross\-functional discipline is critical. Cross\-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision\-making.
* Demonstrate account\-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.).
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3\+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2\+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor\-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top\-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical \& analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.

  

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $120,000 to $130,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Our ability to collaborate and problem\-solve makes a difference in patients’ lives daily. By joining one of our account management teams, you will partner with industry experts and be empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy needed to successfully navigate the complex market access landscape. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*


At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality\-of\-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

new_jobs.description:
Marketing \- San Francisco

  


**About the Team**


Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes to our broader mission of ensuring that artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We help people understand what AI makes possible through the experiences of the people, communities, and customers using it.


We work closely with Social, Community, Communications, Creative, Production, and other teams to bring those experiences to life. Our work connects human stories with integrated marketing programs that build understanding and inspiration with our key audience.


**About the Role**


We’re looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager to identify and curate the strongest proof points of AI’s impact—across people, communities, and society—and turn them into stories and programs that resonate.


You’ll be a builder and storyteller with the curiosity to uncover an extraordinary story and the initiative to make something of it. You’ll seek out people using AI in meaningful ways, build relationships, understand what has changed for them, and help them share their experiences in their own voices.


Working deeply with Social, Community, and Communications, you’ll shape stories together and build the programs, content, and distribution plans that help them travel. That could mean developing a recurring story series, bringing a community’s experience to a national audience, or turning a customer story into a program that invites others to participate.


You’ll combine strong editorial instincts with integrated marketing leadership, taking work from discovery and a clear brief through production, launch, and measurement. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable shaping an ambitious idea, facilitating a conversation with a story participant, and organizing the people and resources needed to bring a program to life.


**In this role, you will:**


* Find the strongest proof points: Proactively discover people, communities, and customers using AI in meaningful ways. Evaluate the evidence, human significance, and audience relevance behind each opportunity.
* Build alongside Social, Community, and Communications: Partner from the outset on story discovery, creative ideas, programming, and distribution. Align on a shared plan, clear roles, and the right moments to bring stories to audiences.
* Turn stories into programs: Create integrated campaigns, recurring content series, community activations, and partnerships that give strong stories a life beyond a single asset or launch.
* Connect national reach with local relevance: Adapt storiesats, messengers, and programs to the audiences and communities they serve. Identify when a local story can resonate nationally and how a national program can become meaningful locally.
* Lead work from idea to delivery: Own briefs, creative development, production, timelines, budgets, partner coordination, launch, and optimization across social, owned, earned, experiential, community, and relevant paid channels.
* Champion craft and credibility: Partner with Creative, producers, and agencies to make distinctive, engaging content. Ground stories in demonstrated impact, bring technical ideas to life through human experiences, and represent participants accurately and thoughtfully.
* Build a repeatable approach: Develop a network of internal and external partners and a practical process for sourcingats and programs that can grow while leaving room to act on unexpected opportunities.
* Measure what resonates: Set clear goals for audience understandingats, and programs we build.

**You will thrive in this role if you have:**


* **Relevant experience:** 12\+ years in integrated marketing, content or editorial strategy, customer storytelling, community marketing, or related fields, including significant experience leading complex campaigns and programs.
* **Strong story instincts:** An ability to spot compelling people, experiences, and outcomes, assess what makes them credible and relevant, and shape a clear narrative for a specific audience.
* **An entrepreneurial mindset:** A track record of building something from zero to 100, creating momentum through ambiguity, and moving between strategy and hands\-on execution.
* **Integrated marketing leadership:** Proven success connecting content, distribution, and audience participation across channels, with strong planning, production, budget, and project\-management skills.
* **Creative and editorial judgment:** Experience shaping briefs and developing work across formats such as video, social, written stories, and live experiences, with a high bar for quality and audience relevance.
* **Communication and influence:** Strong writing, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to make complex ideas clear, build alignment, and influence decisions at the executive level.
* **Deep cross\-functional collaboration:** A track record of building programs with Social, Community, Communications, Creative, and other partners, bringing different perspectives together around a shared objective.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience telling stories about AI or emerging technology through concrete human experiences and demonstrated outcomes.
* Experience building customer advocacy, community storytelling, or ambassador programs that surface compelling voices and encourage participation.
* Experience with documentary, editorial, or other storytelling that involves working directly with participants, from initial interviews through production.
* Experience developing local partnerships, events, or community programs and connecting them to broader campaigns.
* Experience managing creative agenciesats or programs.
* Hands\-on familiarity with AI tools and curiosity about how people use them to work, learn, create, and solve problems.

**Workplace \& Location**


* San Francisco, CA. This role requires a hybrid schedule with an in office requirement from Monday \- Wednesday.

new_jobs.description:

Asset Living is a third\-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single\-family home rentals, affordable housing, build\-to\-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.  



  

Asset Living is a fast\-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed’. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.  



  

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

 **ASSISTANT COMMUNITY MANAGER**


The Assistant Community Manager is responsible for overseeing, under the supervision of the Community Manager, the everyday operations and financial functions of the housing community. As the Assistant Community Manager, you will play a vital role in the delinquency and collection of rent to optimize the property's cash flow and financial position. As an Assistant Community Manager, you will manage all phases of the operations, including personnel, leasing, maintenance, financial, administration \& risk management in the absence of the Community Manager. As an on\-site leader, you will supervise all aspects of the property and staff to ensure compliance with the company's policies and procedures, safety and fair housing guidelines, and liability concerns.


As a leading affordable housing management company, we prefer the following experience in addition to the Essential Duties and Responsibilities outlined below for our affordable assets :

* *Minimum of 1 year experience with affordable housing programs, including but not limited to : LIHTC, HUD (Project Based Section 8, Section 236, PRAC, 811 PRA, USDA \- Rural Development (515\), HCD, HOME Funds and Bonds)*
* *Affordable Housing Accreditation (HCCP, HCP\-E, COS, BOS, TCS, CPO) or other applicable designations in affordable programs are preferred but not required.*

 **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**


Financial Management

* Responsible for posting all payments and income received from all applicants, current residents, and non\-current residents accurately, timely, and efficiently.
* Responsible for processing and reconciling daily all account receivables.
* Monitor and follow up on bad debt to include preparation of late notices, resident and guarantor contact, and filing evictions.
* Responsible for helping the property meet budgeted revenues, expenses, and Net Operating Income.
* Responsible for posting of all charges to resident and non\-current resident accounts; to also include bill back of utilities where applicable.
* Responsible for all end\-of\-the\-month closing procedures and reporting.
* Maintain accurate and organized records; audit resident files to ensure accurate records.
* Responsible for walking units and posting all move\-out charges, statements, and security deposit refunds.

  

Personnel Management

* Regular/daily onsite attendance is required
* Use consistent techniques \& company directives to screen, hire, train, coach, and develop onsite staff.
* Ensure the effectiveness of staff through ongoing training, coaching, counseling, and guidance in compliance with Asset training benchmarks.
* Promote harmony and quality job performance of staff through support and effective leadership.
* Ensure staff compliance and consistency with Company policies and procedures.
* Strategic Leasing Management
* Ensure staff leasing techniques are effective in obtaining closure, follow\-up procedures met, signing/documentation of leases, and reporting systems are accurate and up to date.
* Implement marketing strategies \& systems put in place by the annual marketing plan.
* Deal with resident complaints, concerns, and requests to ensure resident satisfaction.
* Develop and implement resident retention programs (i.e., resident functions, special promotions, monthly newsletter, etc.)
* Effectively show, lease, and move in prospective residents.

  

Administrative Management

* Manage excellent customer service and monitor service request turnaround and responsiveness of maintenance staff.
* Maintain property appearance and ensure repairs are noted and completed on a timely basis (this requires regular property inspections and tours)
* Assist with supervision of all business functions related to operations.
* Plan for and utilize property resources, equipment, and supplies economically (i.e., obtaining bids/pricing from vendors, suppliers, contractors, dealing with inadequate service, etc.)

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**Location:** Sunnyvale, CA


**Experience:** 0\-3 Years


**Position:** 4 days in office in Sunnyvale


**About us:**

Fortinet’s mission is to deliver the most innovative, highest\-performing network security fabric to secure and simplify IT infrastructures. We are a leading global provider of Network Security Solutions for carriers, datacenters, enterprises, and distributed offices. We have proven to be a truly innovative technology driven network Security Company with over 1400 registered Global Patents.


We are looking for a talented, driven, and self\-motivated individual to join us as Business Development Representative. Fortinet is welcoming recent college graduates and are ready to thrive in a fast\-paced environment! As an Entry\-level Business Development Representative, you will have the opportunity to learn about the industry, and set the foundation for career advancement.


**As a BDR, you will:**

* Learn and demonstrate a fundamental understanding of Fortinet’s technology in order to articulate our value proposition to decision\-makers, as well as being able to successfully manage and overcome objections.
* Research customers, identify decision makers, educate prospects and qualify buying interest and sense of urgency.
* Prospecting into multiple organizations via calling, networking and e\-mail, with the help of cutting\-edge digital platforms for intent based leads such as Bombora and 6Sense, and contact discovery using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Discover.org, and other digital tools and Internet sources, to build and maintain a high\-quality lead pipeline.
* Schedule well qualified appointments with key decision makers within targeted companies.
* Meet and exceed daily and weekly call goals, as well as deliver a high quantity of well qualified sales opportunities.
* Maintain accurate activity, contact, and account information of all customers and prospects in our CRM (Salesforce).
* Work closely with Sales, Marketing and other Fortinet business functions in the development of strategic sales approaches.

**Requirements:**

* Self\-starter with positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing and presentation skills; ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities
* Excellent organization skills, attention to detail, customer focus, curiosity and highly data\-driven are musts Basic knowledge in IT or cybersecurity
* Ability to work in a high\-energy sales team environment; phenomenal and collaborative teammate

**What you can expect from us:**

* On the job and formal online training and development opportunities, with the possibility to get the industry recognized certifications.
* An excellent role to start a career in enterprise technology sales, with opportunities to get involved with marketing, technology operations and sales
* Employee days to meet and learn about our key sponsorships and events

Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program.


Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. On target earnings for this position is expected to be $55,000 \- $70,000 per year. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.


All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program, and this position is also eligible for commissions based on the terms of the Sales Compensation Plan

Nimble is an AI robotics company building the autonomous supply chain to power fast, efficient and economical commerce. We’re training robot AGI to power a proprietary generalist supply chain superhumanoid, the first robot in the world capable of performing thousands of tasks across the supply chain. We’ve raised over $220M at over $1B valuation and formed a strategic alliance with FedEx to build a national network of autonomous warehouses capable of generating many billions in annual revenue. We are a hardcore and obsessed team of the world’s best engineers and operators. If you are obsessed with your craft, enjoy a high\-intensity and fast moving high impact environment, are super high agency in getting hard things done and want to be part of building the world’s most legendary robotics company at the most pivotal moment in history, we want to work with you.

Let’s be legendary.

  



**Why Join Nimble?**

**Why Join ADAPT?**


It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.


For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.

**SUMMARY**


Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. This role fosters dignity, respect, and learning while helping to create a safe, supportive, and homelike environment. The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill\-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


The duties and responsibilities of the Residential Program Specialist II will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.
* Ensures the safety, health, and well\-being of the people we support at all times.
* Teaches and assists with activities of daily living (ADLs), including self\-help, social, and community living skills.
* Maintains a personalized, homelike, and respectful atmosphere within the residence.
* Participates actively in interdisciplinary treatment plans and implements individualized program goals.
* Documents daily activities, progress notes, incident reports, and other required records accurately and in a timely manner.
* Responds to crisis situations and medical emergencies, including providing first aid and contacting emergency personnel as needed.
* Contacts emergency personnel (police, fire, ambulance) when necessary to ensure safety of the people we support and staff.

* Assists with meal planning, grocery shopping, and meal preparation to promote nutrition and independence.
* Participates in housekeeping, laundry, and light maintenance tasks to ensure a safe, clean, and supportive environment.
* Attends and participates in staff meetings, trainings, and in\-service sessions to support ongoing development and quality care.
* Promotes dignity, respect, and person\-centered approaches in all interactions with the people we support, families, and staff.
* Maintains confidentiality of all resident information and documentation.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* High School Diploma or GED required.

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
* Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.

**Position:** Program Coordinator, Collegiate Programs

**Department:** Pre\-College and Collegiate Division (PCD)  

**Location:** New York  

**Reports to:** Senior Program Manager, Collegiate Programs

**Classification:** Permanent, Full Time  

**Start Date:** Immediate

**Hours**: Approximately 40 hours per week during business hours 9am – 5pm, Monday – Friday; some


evening and weekend work required; additional hours may be pre\-approved by the Senior Program Manager during periods of high delivery demands.  

**Salary:** $24 / hr.

**Position Context**


Edconic is a successful group of education businesses, including Sotheby’s Institute of Art, The School of The New York Times, Manchester City Sports Business School, and Vogue College of Fashion. Its mission is to build compelling education programs in partnership with the world’s best brands. The Pre\-College and Collegiate Division (PCD) supports its expansion and plans for growth by working across schools on the development and delivery of non\-MA programs.


 The Program Coordinator, Collegiate Programs role is integral to the delivery of Collegiate Program within Sotheby’s Institute of Art – New York, Vogue College of Fashion – New York, and School of the New York Times. Sotheby’s Institute of Art, founded by Sotheby’s Auction House in 1969, has pioneered the education of arts professionals and offers a wide range of Masters’ degrees, semester courses, and professional programs. Since 2004, Vogue College of Fashion has been providing students with the knowledge, networks and practical experience to become future leaders in the fashion industry and offers a range of degree and non\-degree programs. School of The New York Times, established in partnership with The New York Times in 2016, provides students with an immersive educational experience rooted in journalism, media, and storytelling. Drawing on the expertise and resources of The New York Times, the School offers a range of programs designed to develop practical skills, critical thinking, and industry knowledge for aspiring journalists, writers, and media professionals. Collegiate (undergraduate) academic courses are validated by the University of Montana.

 **Role Purpose**  

 The Program Coordinator plays an essential role in the preparation and successful delivery of Collegiate Programs. Reporting to the Senior Program Manager, this role supports the planning, developing, and execution of program delivery and contributing to the overall operations of Collegiate, ensuring a well\-organized program.


The role includes responsibilities such as coordinating co\-curricular activities, onboarding faculty and guest speakers, handling class materials, overseeing logistics, and facilitating communication between staff, faculty, guest speakers and students. The Program Coordinator also supports student needs and assists with general operational tasks throughout the program.


Serving as a primary point of contact for students and course leaders, the Program Coordinator will liaise with internal departments including facilities and IT. They will also work closely with colleagues to provide consistent, high\-quality administrative support to both students and staff.


This is a full\-time position that requires **on\-site support** during program delivery, or as directed by the Senior Program Manager. The role will include some evening and weekend hours, as well as additional duties as required with reasonable notice.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


The Program Coordinator plays a vital role in supporting the planning and delivery of Collegiate programs, ensuring a high\-quality and well\-organized experience for students, faculty, and partners. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* **Program Delivery \& Operations:**  

 Support the coordination and execution of all on\-the\-ground program operations, including scheduling, catering, transportation, classroom logistics, and site visits. Ensure all activities run smoothly and efficiently.
* **Site Visits \& Events Coordination:**  

Organize, book, and track logistics for site visits, co\-curricular activities, and student events. Serve as a chaperone when needed.
* **Classroom \& Materials Management:**  

 Prepare and distribute class materials, supplies, and resources, ensuring all program\-related materials are delivered accurately and on time.
* **Guest Speaker \& Faculty Support:**
	+ Coordinate guest speaker logistics, including onboarding documentation, contracts, payments, scheduling, and technical setup (e.g., Zoom).
	+ Provide ongoing support to faculty and assist with faculty\-related activities and events. Meet with faculty prior to the program to review course content, identify teaching support needs, and confirm classroom requirements.
* **Communication \& Stakeholder Coordination:**  

 Act as a key point of contact for students, faculty, and course leaders. Manage program communications, including monitoring shared inboxes, and facilitating coordination with internal departments (Facilities and IT) and external vendors.
* **Student Support \& Welfare:**  

 Provide day\-to\-day support to students, responding to inquiries and addressing concerns. Monitor student wellbeing and escalate issues as appropriate to senior staff. Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and supportive environment.
* **Administrative \& Financial Support:**  

 Maintain accurate records, track budgets, process invoices, and support financial reporting. Assist with purchasing tickets, supplies, and other program\-related items.
* **Systems \& Data Management:**  

 Maintain student\-facing platforms (e.g., Canvas) with up\-to\-date schedules, course materials, and resources. Track and manage program data using internal systems.
* **Program Activities \& Engagement:**  

 Support in organizing and delivering virtual and in\-person pre\-program orientations, in\-person orientation sessions, ongoing student engagement

A to Z Media is seeking a detail\-oriented Apparel \& Promotional Product Development Coordinator. In this role, you will serve as the operational backbone of our merchandise department, executing and tracking product development, logistics, and vendor coordination for a diverse roster of music and brand clients.  

  

This role will focus on the seamless execution of merchandise programs, from initial start to final delivery. This role is ideal for a proactive, highly organized individual with a passion for music who thrives on cross\-functional collaboration, precise timeline management, and hands\-on problem solving.  

  

**What You’ll Do**  

  

**Product Development \& Timeline Tracking**  

  

\- Production Tracking \- manage the day\-to\-day product lifecycle, tracking items through the design, proofing, manufacturing, and final delivery stages  

\- Art Trafficking \- work closely with the internal Art Department to route design assets and proofs, ensuring client approvals are secured and accurate  

\- Schedule Maintenance \- maintain an up\-to\-date production calendar and generate weekly status reports to ensure all open projects stay on schedule  

\- Quality Control \- monitor pre\-production samples for quality issues, coordinate client approvals, and flag any discrepancies immediately  

  

**Vendor \& Sourcing Coordination**  

  

\- Vendor Liaison \- serve as a point of contact for our global vendor network to secure pricing, proofs, production timelines, and shipping methods  

\- Order Administration \- issue accurate Purchase Orders (POs) to vendors, confirm receipt, and monitor vendor portals for completion dates  

\- Sourcing Support \- assist in researching and vetting new vendors and manufacturers to expand apparel and promotional product options  

  

**Client Services \& Communication**  

  

\- Account Management \- maintain regular, clear communication (via email, Slack, Zoom, and phone) with clients, managers, and sales teams regarding job statuses  

\- Asset Creation \- assist in compiling internal pitch decks and monthly recaps showcasing newly developed products  

\- Issue Resolution \- act as a responsive point of contact for client claims, following established procedures to correct production or delivery errors swiftly  

  

**Logistics, Data, \& Order Administration**  

  

\- Database Accuracy \- maintain accurate and real\-time records of milestones, production notes, and shipping details within our custom database  

\- Financial Administration \- generate and issue accurate client invoices upon project completion; coordinate VAT and domestic sales tax billing with the finance team  

\- Inventory \& Warehouse Coordination \- liaise with the warehouse team to coordinate incoming shipments, pickups, physical inventory counts, and product reworks  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

\- Experience \- 2 \- 4 years of relevant experience in product coordination, apparel production, account \- management, or merchandise operations  

\- Industry Knowledge \- direct experience working within an apparel, promotional products, or music merchandise environment is highly preferred  

\- Project Management \- proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment  

\- Communication \- exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both business executives and creative artists/managers  

\- Adaptability \- high comfort level working in a dynamic environment, with a "can\-do" attitude and a knack for proactive problem\-solving  

  

**Key Skill Set**  

  

\- Extreme Attention to Detail \- inherent focus on follow\-through, database accuracy, and order precision  

\- Cross\-Functional Collaboration \- ability to act as a seamless bridge between sales, art, logistics, accounting, and external partners.  

\- Logistical Aptitude \- understanding of shipping, tracking, warehousing, and production workflows  

\- Creative Alignment \- a strong eye for product quality and design, combined with a genuine passion for music culture and artist branding.  

  

Founded in 1994, A to Z Media is a family\-owned company specializing in Vinyl, CD, DVD, Promotional Product and Apparel, and Manufacturing Services. Our clients range from indie labels and branding agencies to distributors and Fortune 500 companies. At A to Z Media, we pride ourselves on being a true partner in bringing creative visions to life.  

  

Full\-Time, Onsite to Hybrid, $45,000 \- $65,000

The TAM will work closely with internal teams, external partners, and third\-party processors, providing technical and strategic support to ensure the successful deployment of Mastercard’s products and services and trusted source for our customers for technical queries. This role requires a blend of technical expertise and business acumen to identify opportunities for optimization within their infrastructure and ensure seamless communication and manage all escalations relating to technical issues.  

  

Additionally, and when required, the Manager, Technology Account Manager will engage with key stakeholders across Mastercard to deliver innovative solutions tailored to complex customer needs.  

  

Role:  

  

* Ensures resolution of day\-to\-day technical/operational issues, customer issues and/or as related to assigned delivery projects
* Identifies and delivers against customer and Mastercard business and corporate objectives, opportunities, and commitments
* Be a strong communicator, works with a sense of agility \& urgency, while delivering quality output to customers and internal partners
* Acts as central point of contact for customers and/or MasterCard customer representatives
* Partners with cross functional partners including Sales, Marketing, and Products throughout Mastercard supporting the internal development and implementation of any new product and/or technology enhancement and support
* Establishes close working relationships with internal and customer's executive\- and decision\-making\-level contacts
* Brings ability to enhance customer experience by driving business growth with portfolio optimization, emerging technologies, and find faster ways to get work done with sustained quality
* Analyzes and improves customer operational performance and profitability through back\-office reviews, ie. chargebacks, authorization, etc
* Identifies and arranges for training and communication of operational enhancements
* Participates in and contributes to account planning with customer and internal partners to


prioritize strategic, mutually shared objectives
  

* Works with internal colleagues to ensure customer's compliance with all Mastercard technology enhancements
* Executes project initiatives and develops quantitative/qualitative report
* Improves product offerings by communicating customers' feedback to Product Management and applicable internal teams

  

All About You:
  

  

* Demonstrated customer and relationship management skills and ability to build and maintain strong, positive working relationships at all functional levels within customer and internal MasterCard organization is essential
* Experience in payments business with preferred area of experience in credit and debit card operations (issuing and acquiring) \- authorizations, clearing, settlement, and fraud \& risk management
* Demonstrated successful Account Management experience
* Ability to manage complexity and simplifying for customers and key stakeholders
* Technology and operations related skills required; project management and implementation skills preferred
* Demonstrated operational excellence in managing escalations and timely responses
* Ability to grasp technology details and translate them into solutions and/or to address business opportunities
* Strong analytical/problem solving and planning skills
* Ability to quickly learn, explain and bridge the gap between the business, product and technology that supports it
* Ability to thrive and effectively collaborate in a dynamic, fast\-paced, team environment that embraces giving, receiving as well as acting on feedback
* Ability and willingness to provide off\-hours support to customers if needed
* College/University degree or equivalent work experience with emphasis on business, and information technology and/or bankcard industry experience
* Information technology and relevant industry experience preferred
* Hybrid position with an expectation to be in office on an average 3 days per week


Mastercard is a merit\-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable\_accommodation@masterc

new_jobs.title: Account Manager II - NYC
new_jobs.description:
Posting Description:
**Do you have experience in Commercial Risk? Are you an inquisitive, organized, meticulous individual who would like to apply their experience to our dynamic and engaging industry? If so, this may be the next step in your career!**

  

This Account Manager II role is based out of our beautiful, New York City office, located in the Financial District.

 **Aon is in the business of better decisions.**

  

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

  

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

 **What the day will look like:**

  

Partner with Account Executives on assigned book of business, manage day\-to\-day service processes and outputs, support a variety of strategic, client\-facing initiatives, and run point on each client’s renewal cycle, ensuring a positive and productive client experience.

 **How this opportunity is different**

  

What makes this opportunity different is the combination of meaningful client impact and Aon’s collaborative culture. In this role, you’ll work closely with colleagues across geographies and solution lines, leveraging Aon’s tools and deep expertise to deliver great outcomes for clients—while benefiting from a supportive environment that prioritizes continuous learning, career development, and personal wellbeing.

 **Skills that will lead to success:**

* Maintains effective and positive relationships with clients. Serves independently in a client\-facing capacity on matters of moderate importance and complexity.
* Facilitates the timely and accurate flow of information between clients, and account team members, keeping all parties informed.
* Handles client open items lists and respond to client ad\-hoc requests.
* Gathers and analyzes data and drafts assigned elements of stewardship reports and other convincing presentations tailored to the needs of the audience and the circumstances of the presentation.
* Actively supports and monitors the renewal process, engaging with account team members as necessary. May draft quote comparisons and is responsible for saving down binders, policies, and endorsements.
* Where applicable, serves as the primary point of contact with Aon Client Services (ACS), coordinating activities of the client service team and ACS to ensure that key processes assigned are performed efficiently and quality of client deliverables.
* Primary collaborator with Premium Accounting on client billing matters.
* Receives and handles routine and sophisticated coverage inquiries and endorsement requests.
* Serves as key client liaison for items such as certificates, auto IDs, location additions, invoices, Worker’s Compensation posting notices, allocations, premium finance agreements, summaries of insurance, and policy transmittals.
* Monitors and follows\-up on invoice generation, fee agreements, receivables, and collections. Addresses and resolves problems.
* May provide guidance and mentoring to a less senior account specialist. Delegates work to support staff and ACS where applicable.
* Ensures tools are understood and used. Performs related duties as assigned.

**Education and Experience:**

* **3\+ years of insurance experience required** (preferably within Commercial Risk and in an Account Management role)
* **Active Property \& Casualty Insurance license required**
* Ability to maintain effective and positive relationships with clients and colleagues
* Effective organization and time management skills
* Ability to communicate effectively, orally and in writing
* Effective presentation skills
* Ability to handle multiple, non\-congruent tasks simultaneously

**Pay Transparency Laws**

  

The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is **$75,000 \- $90,000**. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location.

  

For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. ***Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate.***  

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. **A summary of all the benefits offered for this position:**  

Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full\-time and regular part\-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long\-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short\-term disability and optional long\-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD\&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies.
